In the popular anime Shuya Marionette, there is a character whom everyone looks upon with scorn: the so-called "Piggy Duke," third son of Duke Denning and a student of Kirsch Mage Institute. If he uses his in-depth knowledge of the anime and his unparalleled power as a master of all the elements, surely Slowe can gain popularity with his peers and change his fate! Perhaps this time, he can make the one small wish that never came to fruition in the anime come true: to become a man worthy of Charlotte, his retainer, and to confess his love to her!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

However, they are surprised to see him confess to a guy, Yashiro's longtime friend Kenta, only for Kenta to turn him down. Although heartbroken, Yashiro tries to joke around with Kenta, but he accidentally gets killed when a truck runs into him.

Yashiro awakens in the presence of the shrine's god and Ukon, and as a show of gratitude, the god decides to restore him back to life to give him a second chance with Kenta. In doing so, the god grants his wish to be reborn as a high school girl and gives her the name Kagura Tendou. However, she soon discovers that the god and Ukon plan to watch over her relationship with Kenta, although she's the only one who can see and hear them.

Tell me how you show your sex appealㅡ
Shoemaker Jin has one problem, it’s that he can’t make shoes with ornate and glamorous design due to his serious and stubborn character. Although when he asked his childhood friend Kei for his help, Kei suggested giving up his virginity in order to bring out Jin’s sex appeal. But even before he loses his virginity, Kei held him andㅡ?!

A tailor made love story between two young artisans.

(Source: SaltyPotatoesTrans)

103094.description: A super-M asks an S&M show player to have sex with him, but the player doesn't count himself as an S, but he still isn't giving up.

103095.description: Pure hearted but filthy minded fudanshi Hanamoto moves to Tokyo to find love and instantly meets the man of his dreams, Tsuchiya. But somehow the realities of love and sex are not as simple and straightforward as all the BL manga he's read has led him to believe.

title.native: ハッピーエンドを信じてる

103096.description: Honma Shouta was born from the Sado region. Due to his parents' death, he dropped out of his university to take care of his younger brother. Amidst the new, tough lifestyle, he met the famous architect, Sakagami Tetsuaki. In order to raise money to live, he accepted a sex proposal of "50 thousand yen a pop". He may seem a bit mean during sex, but he's been showing his kind, familial side outside of their sex life. What's next for Shouta, who seems to be falling for him...?!
synonyms: How to make love with a "SADO" man

title.romaji: Sado no Otoko wo Otosu Houhou

103097.description: Matsuoka is a transfer student whose wish is to make 100 friends. He gets along with his classmates almost at once, and it all looks be smooth sailing, until he crosses paths with the school's most feared delinquent, Sougo! One thing leads to another and... Sougo ends up becoming Matsuoka's slave!?

title.native: ご主人さまとは言わせません!

103098.description:
Mashiro Shimazaki is a 23-year-old college student and he's got the worst luck in the world. He gets mistaken for a groper on the train, a girl asks him out thinking he's someone else... He just can't catch a break. He even ends up stepping on a frighteningly-beautiful "incubus" on his way home......! The incubus - calling himself Nijo - uses unworldly powers to draw Mashiro into seductive pleasures to quench his "hunger." Nijo's tongue drains Mashiro of his strength and he touches Mashiro in places he's never been touched before... With this arrogant incubus and Mr. Unlucky shacking up together, let the pleasures begin!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Don't Eat Too Much! -I Picked up an Incubus!?
title.native: 喰べすぎ禁止！～拾った男はインキュバス！？～
title.romaji: Tabesugi Kinshi!: Hirotta Otoko wa Incubus!?

103099.description:
"I'm going to make you a substitute." I saw my Prince Charming for the first time in ten years. He calls my long-lost twin sister's name while making love to me... Left with no one to turn to, Iroha is taken to a house and the owner of the house turns out to be the boy she met when she was a little girl! But what Arashi wants is her sister, and he uses Iroha to satisfy his desires... "If you want me to like you, prove it." Iroha doesn't like seeing Arashi sad, so she has sex with him every day, hoping that it'll make him smile... One day, Iroha finds herself inside the room she's not supposed to enter...! What's going on in this place...!?

(Source: Renta!

103100.description:
The Pretty Boy Detective Club, a mysterious organisation that's rumoured to solve problems at Yubiwa Academy...

Manabu the Aesthete
Michiru the Epicure
Hyouta the Adonis
Nagahiro the Orator
Sousaku the Artiste

To search for a star she glimpsed 10 years ago, second-year student Mayumi Doujima calls on these five Pretty Boys to help her solve the case! Which Pretty Boy is your favorite!?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

103101.description:
Yuzuki Madoka is an avid animal lover going to school to be a pet groomer in the future. One day, a hot college student, Shiro Kuon, moves in next door. He's sweet, too, and Yuzuki gradually finds herself drawn to him... but Shiro has a secret!! We're sure you'll love the ever-popular Hiraku Miura's sweet love story full of mystery!!

(Source: Renta!)

103102.description:
This is a world of the skies, where many islands drift in the sky. A boy named Gran and a talking winged lizard named Vyrn lived in Zinkenstill, an island which yields mysteries. One day, they come across a girl named Lyria. Lyria had escaped from the Erste Empire, a military government that is trying to rule over this world using powerful military prowess. In order to escape from the Empire, Gran and Lyria head out into the vast skies, holding the letter Gran's father left behind—which said, "I will be waiting at Estalucia, Island of Stars."

(Source: Aniplex of America)

title.native: グランブルーファンタジー

103103.description:
Manga adaptation of the fourth novel of Kyogoku Natsuhiko's Hyakki Yakou series.

The story follows antique store worker Imagawa, aging doctor Kuonji, and writer Sekiguchi, who are all fascinated by mysterious events happening in Hakone, including a series of murders of Buddhist monks and a little girl in a kimono who wanders through the mountains.

103104.description:
Manga adaptation of the fifth novel of Natsuhiko Kyogoku's Hyakki Yakou Series.

The story begins with a supernatural murder mystery in an all-girls school. Sayako and Miyuki both attend a high class private religious all-girls school, and one of the bonds of their friendship is that neither of them come from a prestigious family. One day, Sayako confides to Miyuki that the teacher Honda-sensei is sexually abusing her. When Sayako hears a school legend that involves asking a demon to curse someone to die, she and Miyuki investigate the possibility.

Miyuki, an atheist, doesn't really believe in the idea of curses, even though she has a schoolmate, Yuko, who has supposedly used this method to have someone killed. Nevertheless, she supports Sayako in carrying out the ritual, in the hopes that it will give her some peace. However, after they speak with Yuko, they must face the fact that the curse may be dangerously real, and may carry with it horrific consequences. Miyuki's world is quickly spiraling into a nightmare!

103105.description:
Former reclusive boy Fuyugo Nakahara in class 2-E made his high school debut as a quiet and cool lone wolf in order to dispel the trauma of his past. And with him, the serious yet charismatic Sakura Igarashi from class 2-F. In the spring of their second year of high school, these two seemingly distant individuals come together and what follows next is…?

(Source: Original publisher, translated)

title.native: 五十嵐くんと中原くん

103106.description: The year is 3992—over a millennium after a series of magnetic storms swept the planet, causing genetic damage and eliminating the Y chromosome from the human genome. Following the total extinction of the male sex, human society has been rebuilt as a gynaecocracy where children are born via surrogacy. Anzai Y'anto Hime begins to come of age as this world's only man.

103107.description: Koharu is 14 years old and goes through thick and thin with her two best friends Miku and Sawa! But then one day the exchange student Leila from Tokyo shows up in her class and the team of three gets shaken - because Koharu suddenly spends much more time with the cool Leila! Miku and Sawa are far from happy that their girlfriend suddenly likes someone else better. Will the girlfriends still be able to pull themselves together?

103108.description:
In a magical land blessed with scenery, there lived a pair of twins. Gilbert, the younger brother, grew into an incredibly skilled toy-maker, whereas Gizel became a clumsy and unpopular nurse. While Gizel was alone with her thoughts, a major accident took place...

(Source: AOC Translations)

103109.description: As a child Tsukiko met a fox spirit. She named him Gin and they promised to marry each other. But because relationships between a person and fox spirit aren't allowed, the fox elder erased their memory. But fate reunites the two years later. Will her love have more luck this time?
synonyms: Rain Shower While the Sun Shines

103111.description:
Igarashi is a hardworking young office lady. Takeda, the senpai above her at work, annoys her constantly–and yet she finds herself growing closer to him. Every day is filled with comic mishaps and romantic moments as Igarashi tries to balance work, life, and love.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

103113.description: Ichiha is on a family vacation with her family in Tokyo. To Ichiha-chan, who is still an elementary school student, everything seems like a new experience. Overwhelmed by the atmosphere of Tokyo's airport, Ichiha-chan gets mixed up into a whirpool of trouble by taking her eyes off her parents for an instant! The start of an adventure of a little girl in Tokyo!

103114.description: Regulations and ethics are scary, but love with school girls is the best! What? A virgin cartoon editor, Kato Kazuyoshi, having a kettle and being in love with Yankee JK Nikaido Ryla.

title.native: ヤンキーＪＫの異常な愛情
title.romaji: Yankee JK no Ijou na Aijou

103115.description:
Although only 19 years old, using his good looks and his body as a weapon, Kanzaki Nao is a natural gigolo. Being stabbed after a breakup, he is saved by a refined and dangerous man who is a Yakuza -- Murou Ryouichi, boss of the Ichinose-group. Stopping Nao from leaving the city after his wounds have healed, Murou brings him to his apartment and offers him a deal in order to pay for Nao’s treatment.

Even though Murou tells him that he’s “not interested in brats”, he’s contradicting his words when he starts kissing Nao like a lover. What will happen to Nao who swears by himself that he definitely won’t fall in love.....?

title.native: やさしく殺して、僕の心を。
title.romaji: Yasashiku Koroshite, Boku no Kokoro O.

103116.description:
Tomako is just a normal housewife. Well... almost normal. She enjoys the trill of stealing things. But one day her sons classmate caches her in the act and puts and end to her shoplifting career.

Note: A live-action AV adaptation (URE-077) was released on January 25th, 2022.

103120.description:
Half-beasts and humans both live together in this world, but species don't usually mix romantically...

Iori is a social worker who helps half-beasts live with humans. He's got a good heart, but he's scared of love. One day he meets the wolf writer, Tsuneaki Gora, in order to introduce him to the orphan wolf boy, Riku. Iori immediately feels something for the wild and hot Tsuneaki, and Tsuneaki seems to like him, too... or, at least his scent, anyway...!!

A heartwarming love story about a shy child wolf and two cute guys who are awkward in love.

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 世界は尻尾でできている

103121.description: I was just a regular office worker on my way home from work, when I had the misfortune to be involved in a traffic accident. Next thing I know, somehow I'm in Edo-period Tokyo, in the red light district?! Is this for real?! Did I somehow slip through time?

103126.description:
After breaking up with his girlfriend, Natsuno is homeless and spending nights in his office. At a mutual acquaintance's wedding celebration he meets up with his old school friend Ui, who had confessed to Natsuno just before graduation, been rejected by him, and drifted out of contact. Now an accident has left Ui with amnesia, and his first words to Natsuno are "Who are you?" Hoping to charm the other man into lending him a place to crash for a while, Natsuno lies, "I'm your ex"...!?

(Source: Rain Over Paradise)

title.native: 悪い大人になりまして

103128.description: The day of his mother's funeral was in the early summer when he turned 17. That was the same day he met Kyouko Yashiro. During the days he felt restless, she was the one who supported him. As long as she was there, then he could continue to live. In the peak of summer, the boy was taken away to "paradise."

103131.description:
"You broke our promise, so I'm breaking up with you."

Two people so in love in high school who decided to elope. Fifteen years later, Kusaka suddenly tells Mikuriya that they should break up. But why?! Mikuriya's so devoted to him, loves him so passionately and has never cheated on him. So he's stressing over this promise that he can't remember. It is then that he recalls a secret that he's never told Kusaka.

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

103132.description:
This is the story about the two of them. Daiki Miné and Fumie Anjo are opposites of each other. Daiki is a serious, work-oriented translator, while Fumie is a friendly neighborhood bus driver with a girlfriend. But somehow, the two became fast friends, much to the surprise of the people around them. As time passes by, the two find themselves drawn to each other a little bit too much, leaving both of them confused. When Fumie's girlfriend breaks with him, he is forced to confront the feelings he had been too dense to realize, try to deny as he might. Meanwhile, Daiki isn't sure of what his place in Fumie's life really is.

(Source: Futekiya)

103133.description:
The manga will show Tanya, Visha, Rerugen, and Zetour in a gourmet-themed story.

(Source: Anime News Network)

103134.description: Childhood friends Shiro and Hiro explore their budding desires, and even as Shiro retreats in fear, they still can't let go of their feelings. A tale of desire, repression, and obsession, weaving a web of twisted love.

title.native: 俺の気持ちがわかるか
title.romaji: Ore no Kimochi ga Wakaru ka

103137.description: A few days in the life of a cynical apparel worker who's stuck in a dead-end job and dating a loser.

103141.description:
On a dark and freezing night, Dr. Sho-an drags home the body of a beautiful man he found buried in the snow. Corpses fetch a high price when turned into medicinal ingredients, and the doctor hopes to rake in a tidy profit to support his practice. Much to his dismay, Dr. Sho-an discovers the man is still alive, and he brings him back from the brink of death. But the doctor's disappointment melts away when his corpse-cum-patient shows him the many delightful uses of a living body!

Although Dr. Sho-an only knows his patient is ex-yakuza, the doctor gives him the name Yuki and tells him to make more corpses for him. Instead, Yuki moves in with the doctor and defends their home with his body and sword.

(Source: Futekiya)

103142.description: After graduating from their constant fighting, some magical girls were unable to keep up in class, got poor grades, and became NEETs. In order to help these poor former magical girls, the cleaning company "Mei Company" was founded! Will swapping their magical staffs for cleaning tools help to rehabilitate them? Gate protagonist Itami's beloved doujin manga about former magical girls cleaning up messes.

103143.description:
Girl distances herself from her best friend when they're kids. As they get older, she regrets it and gets jealous when he talks to other girls, so she does the obvious thing to get them back together.

This is an original doujin manga about being lovey-dovey with the gyaru-ish but awkward Sasamori-san.

(Source: Melonbooks, translated)

Released at SC2016 Winter.

103144.description:
Khang Zhipa is a 13-year-old doctor’s apprentice living in a mountain village in 18th-century Tibet. One day, when he gets back from collecting medicinal herbs, he finds a bride-to-be and her wedding party will be resting at his home for the night. The bride’s name is Moshi Rati and it turns out she’s actually Khang Zhipa’s fiancee from another land, here to stay! Enjoy this heartwarming slice-of-life tale woven by a kind-hearted boy and his mysterious bride.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

103145.description:
Just spend three seconds of your day on this three-panel comic!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

103146.description:
"I know all too well...the beginning of that diary I never wrote-"

Ellen, who has been plagued by sickness her whole life, heavily relies on her mother's care and love. When the bond between them decays in a horrific turn of events, Ellen despairs that she'll never get the love she so desperately craves and thinks she's done for-that is, until she crosses paths with a mysterious black cat. The cat offers her powers and a house to live in, which seems to change Ellen's life for the better. But the new witch soon discovers the gruesome secrets within this ever-changing house...

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: The Witch's House: The Diary of Ellen
title.native: 魔女の家 エレンの日記
title.romaji: Majo no Ie: Ellen no Nikki

title.native: ドキドキしすたー♡葵ちゃん

103150.description:
Volume 1: Doronuma
Volume 2: Doronuma ~Because I Love you~

103151.description: A guy waiting at a bus stop one hot, summer night meets a girl wearing what he thinks is a rather peculiar outfit.

103153.description: The story takes place in a world with humanity on the verge of extinction due to the rise of zombies. A young man named Aoki travels through this ruined world and meets a mysterious zombie girl who does not try to eat him and, further, says his name?

103155.description:
In the "Kani Magazine" series, readers are introduced to the real on-goings at a popular eromanga publisher! Veteran hentai editor Satou is trying hard to make her assignments go smoothly, but problems keep popping up. She’s either having problems with one of her more popular artists falling behind on her deadlines, or she’s spending her time training up a virgin artist who wouldn’t know what’s sexy if it was smothering him. With artists like these, her workload keeps piling up, maybe she’ll have to take a more hands on approach to eromanga making.

The "S&M Triangle" arc focuses on Shion, a maid who redefines the concepts of master and servant. She is a proper and diligent maid to the family who employs her, but she is also a very firm and dominant figure in their lives. When her masters do not exhibit the traits fitting of a maid of her caliber, she is more than willing to put them in their place. And when they treat her well, she affectionately works hard to earn her keep.

Whether grinding over deadlines or sadistically training their employers, the ladies in Michiking's latest are masterful sexual technicians ready to serve and be served!

(Source: FAKKU!)

103156.description:
Meet the Skeleton Soldier, a meager but fiercely loyal fighter who serves to protect its master, Lady Succubus. Its dream of a peaceful life with her is shattered when they're both brutally murdered by a group of warriors one day. But what would’ve been a pathetic end to an unremarkable soul sparks a new beginning: when the Skeleton Soldier opens its eyes again, it has traveled back 20 years in time! “I must warn Lady Succubus of all the things to come!” But with no special combat skills and a history of failure and defeat, how can it stop the horrible events from unfolding again? Follow the Skeleton Soldier as it faces the most challenging quest of all—rewriting the ending to its own story.

(Source: TappyToon)

骸骨兵士はダンジョンを守れなかった
从1级开始的异世界骑士
พลทหารโครงกระดูกผู้มิอาจปกป้องดันเจี้ยน

103157.description:
The Sea Kingdom was invaded by the Totsusa Kingdom, but Wadanohara and her familiars managed to hold them back. The two princesses faced off with one another -- and suddenly the two kingdoms were at peace.

The war was seemingly over.... However, Wadanohara's original familiar, Samekichi, was thinking.
"Wadanohara.. I will definitely... protect you."

What are his true intentions? All will be revealed soon.
synonyms: Wadanohara and The Great Blue Sea: The Sea of Death

title.native: 大海原と大海原 死の海編
title.romaji: Oounabara to Wadanohara: Shi no Umi-hen

103158.description:
Tomoki Okumura is a young man who is kicked out of his apartment. Looking for a job he spots an ad for an assistant position. He meets a man, Niwa, for the interview but soon finds out that this isn't your normal interview nor is Niwa your normal porn director. A story of firsts for both the naive and the experienced.

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

103165.description:
Simo Häyhä's adventures continue after the Winter War.

In June 1941 Finland launches an attack to reclaim the territories lost to the Soviet Union in what ended up being called the Continuation War.

title.native: 白い魔女 美しきスナイパー

103180.description:
In a world haunted by dangerous supernatural forces, there are still some problems you can't solve no matter how much spiritual power you have. And a good thing too--because phony exorcist Reigen Arataka doesn't have any!

But that's never stopped Reigen from running a ghostbusting business...and his new part-time office assistant is none other than Tome Kurata, a girl obsesssed with the strange and unxplained--and the schoolmate of Reigen's protégé, Shigeo "Mob" Kageyama. Yet whereas Mob's incredible psychic strength resolved many a case for Reigen, Tome is as powerless as her boss! Or so she may think at first...but if there's one thing a master scam artist knows how to teach, it's the power of confidence and belief!

(Source: Dark Horse)
synonyms: REIGEN หมอผีพลังMAX 131
MobPsycho 100 REIGEN Das größte Medium des 21. Jahrhunderts
Reigen O Homem com Poder Espiritual Máximo de 131

103183.description:
Left devastated after the tragic death of his parents and sister, Yuuichi Tachibana adopts his seven-year-old nephew, Ayumu. Seeking a new beginning, he chooses to move them to a new house with a view of the ocean, hoping for a peaceful setting where they can concentrate on their healing.

There they meet Ryou Kurebayashi, who owns a neighborhood deli, and become regular customers. As Ryou and Yuuichi grow closer, learning about each other's unfortunately similarly tragic pasts, they begin to support one another ― and Ayumu ― day by day, building a little family of their own by the sea.

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Kiedy morska bryza tuli pisklę do snu...
El polluelo dormido en la orilla del mar

title.native: 雛鳥は汐風にまどろむ

103184.description:
Meet Amane Mizuno a girl with fierce sanpaku eyes and a pure heart! She has recently fallen for a boy named Katou, who has the exact opposite attitude! Will the tender-hearted Amane ever tell him how she feels?!

(Source: Denpa)

- Chapter count includes a bonus chapter.
- Originally self-published on Twitter, after six chapters it was serialised by GANGANpixiv.

103185.description: An artist picks up a tattooed man off the streets. Though their relationship develops fruitfully, circumstances from the past conspire to tear them apart.

103186.description: Hisoka's Past is a prequel one-shot of Hunter × Hunter focusing on the character Hisoka, written and illustrated by Sui Ishida, creator of the Tokyo Ghoul series.

103187.description: A young man finds an amnesiac guy who's dressed like a pilot, and a (rather confusing) sequence of events begins to unfold.

103188.description: As the two with opposite personalities get closer, a love story starts.
synonyms: Ano Ko no Hana ga Hoshii

103189.description: A young high school boy falls in love with the ghost of a student.

103190.description:
Koharu’s has lived her young life by her mother’s motto: a good woman never gets rejected. But when the most popular guy in school turns her down before she even gets the words out, her whole world comes crashing down … until she realizes, if she just keeps confessing, she’ll never get rejected! And as an unlikely friendship begins between the two, she’s given an ultimatum: he’ll say yes when his heart leans 100% towards her! A goofy, assertive romantic comedy!

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: I say "I love you" now! Senpai!

103191.description:
Stuck in a rut and plagued with debt, Rio Kijima is at the lowest point of his life when he bumps into Shiro Kido at a funeral. Kido, freshly kicked to the curb by his ex-girlfriend, is Kijima’s former classmate and has a history with him. Despite their past, Kido realizes that they have what each other needs. Kijima offers hot-headed Kido a place to live. Kido gives Kijima a new purpose. As Kido nudges Kijima to come to terms with a drastic career change, he struggles to pull them both out of their Mood Indigo.

(Source: Futekiya)

103192.description:
Rocker Hikaru and studious Rihito met and fell in love when they were high school classmates. Now, three years after graduation, Hikaru is still in their hometown trying to get his music career going while Rihito is studying in Kyoto. The two are desperate to make their long-distance relationship work, but can young love overcome adult hardships?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

103193.description: A hedgehog finds his way into the house of a man who can communicate with animals.
synonyms: Hedgehog Kuremi in the King's House

title.native: 針棘クレミーと王の家
title.romaji: Haritoge Kuremi to Ou no Ie

103194.description: The story of the nine stage girls from Seisho Music Academy and their daily lives before the TV Anime!

title.native: 少女☆歌劇 レヴュースタァライト オーバーチュア

103195.description:
In 2006, a patient of a psychologist in New York sketched the portrait of a man she had repeatedly seen in her dreams. After several other patients claimed to have seen the same person in their dreams, the image was made public. Soon, there were reports from many others around the world who claimed that the same man appeared in their sleep. "This Man"—as he came to be known—eventually became nothing more than an urban legend.

In present-day Japan, forensic sketch artist Hakaru Amano uses his illustration skills to assist the Kumamoto Metropolitan Police. His life, however, changes when he meets Hoshiko Akesato, who approaches Hakaru in hopes that he can draw the man that appeared outside her home the week before. When he finishes his sketch, he is surprised to see that it is the same face as This Man.

Not long afterward, Hoshiko witnesses This Man brutally murder her mother while Hakaru's apartment is set on fire. When the artist finally encounters This Man outside his building, Hakaru is given an ominous warning that death awaits those who lay eyes on This Man. When it becomes clear that the mysterious perpetrator has allies within the city, Hakaru and Hoshiko are forced into hiding. Nevertheless, Hakaru resolves to hunt down and capture This Man and his accomplices before they can strike again.
synonyms: This Man: Death to Those Who See That Face

title.native: THIS MAN その顔を見た者には死を
title.romaji: THIS MAN: Sono Kao wo Mita Mono ni wa Shi wo

103196.description:
Aozuki Takashi, the best friend of his beloved little brother transferred to the old dormitory where Minase lives. Minase's heart raise its beat to see Takashi grown mature. Meanwhile, Takashi had feelings for Minase. Minase was going to ask his little brother Tetsuo about Takashi but Takashi seems to have some secrets…

(Source: Salty Potatoes)

103197.description:
Eight years ago, Mochizuki Saya was raped and murdered by three juvenile delinquents. Protected under the Juvenile Act, the delinquents have been allowed to re-enter society... but Mochizuki Wakaru, Saya's younger brother, hasn't forgotten their crime and wishes for their punishment.

Not long after his sister's death anniversary, he decides to look for those responsible, however, he is run over with a bike by one of the delinquents and hospitalized. While at the hospital, he awakes the ability to interact with other people's dreams and discovers that these interactions bring real-life effects. Knowing that his ability allows him to do a "perfect crime," he vows to avenge his sister... when night falls.
synonyms: J’irai te tuer dans tes rêves

title.romaji: Yoru ni naru to Boku wa

103198.description:
On the night of a full moon, Do-Gyeong runs into a vampire with blood dripping from the corners of his mouth. Haunted by the encounter, he tries to dismiss it as a dream...but not only does the vampire go to the same school as him, he begins following him around everywhere! Do-Gyeong is horrified of course, but as time passes, he discovers some peculiar quirks about the creature: he prefers his meat well done, flinches at the sight of cats, and loves to cuddle. Who is this mysterious vampire, and why is he so fixated on Do-Gyeong?

(Source: Lezhin, edited)

103199.description:
A manga series depicting the prologue story of and for Gravity Rush 2, the Playstation 4 exclusive, following Kat and her companions.

Adaptation of Gravity Rush: The Animation - Overture.

Included chapters: 0

title.native: GRAVITY DAZE 2 重力的眩暈追想譚
あなたのためのハッピーエンド
title.romaji: Anata no Tame no Happy End

103201.description:
Mitsui's life has been thoroughly torn apart. And just when he is confronted with the reality that is his life, he runs into his old classmate and former friend Sone. Although years have gone by since their schooldays together, neither one has been able to forget their past: Mitsui rejected Sone for being gay. Now that they have reconnected, Mitsui's only interest is to shame and continue to reject Sone for his identity. But is Mitsui merely projecting...? With complex emotions and a twisted past, Mitsui may also be a victim of his circumstances.

(Source: Manga Planet)

103202.description:
It's been ten years since Miyako fled from feelings about his childhood friend. Only the invitation to their wedding brings the two back in contact with each other. While Miyako is still trying to forget his unfulfilled love finally, another man suddenly appears on the scene. Yuya, the younger and most attractive brother of his childhood crush, admits Miyako his years of affection and thus ignites a storm of old and new desires...

(Source: KAZÉ, translated)

title.native: 彼の初恋は、毒か或いは。
title.romaji: Kare no Hatsukoi wa, Doku ka Arui wa.

103203.description:
A tragedy wipes out Hiroto Amamiya’s whole class. A god suddenly appears and says he will give all of them special protection and skills before reincarnating them in a new world. But when the god makes a mistake, Hiroto goes into his new life without anything at all.

(Source: One Peace Books)
synonyms: The Death Mage Who Doesn't Want a Fourth Time

title.native: 四度目は嫌な死属性魔術師
title.romaji: Yondome wa Iyana Shi Zokusei Majutsushi

103204.description:
Crown prince Cecil was so brilliant that everything in life was easy to the point of boring him, then one day, his fiancée Bertia suddenly said "Prince Cecil, I am a villainess!" Claiming that this world is the same as that of an "otome game" from her past life and that she is playing the role of the "villainess" in it, she aims to play her part well and have their engagement annulled. With that goal in mind, she sets about causing turmoil in Cecil's daily life.

Note: Chapter count contains 4 extra chapter.
synonyms: Fiance's Observation Log of the Self-proclaimed Villainess
บันทึกสังเกตการณ์คู่หมั้นผู้ประกาศตัวเป็นนางร้าย

title.english: An Observation Log of My Fiancée Who Calls Herself a Villainess
title.native: 自称悪役令嬢な婚約者の観察記録。
title.romaji: Jishou Akuyaku Reijou na Konyakusha no Kansatsu Kiroku.

103205.description:
Two miracles are happening to the high schooler Naoyuki Ono's life. The first is him going out with a beauty of his school, Shiori Sakura. The second is that she turns into her thick-headed father if Ono touches her. The cute girlfriend and her terrifying father are stuck in one body. Even if he wants to touch her, he can't.

And so, the curtain rises on this father-daughter fusion love comedy!

103206.description:
A handsome knight visits Baum's place who has spent mostly quiet days in his entire life. Baum's life is about to get colorful in more ways than one.

Notes: This work includes 6 extra chapters.
synonyms: あなたの森〜神と魔法の導き〜

103207.description:
When college student Ban Chan hits his wealthy underclassman Doyun's car with his motorcycle and runs off without taking responsibility, Doyun tracks him down and informs him that he owes him 10 million won in damages. Broke, in debt and unable to escape the consequences of his hit-and-run, Ban Chan loses his girlfriend and his job and ends up working as Doyun's temporary housekeeper. As the two young men get to know each other better, Ban Chan learns that Doyun's family is rather dysfunctional. He was abused by his brother for being gay, and he's being stalked by his obsessed step-sister who refuses to believe it and has convinced herself that he will one day marry her. To get rid of her, Doyun offers to reduce Ban Chan's debt if he pretends to be his lover, and he agrees. But what happens when this fake couple develops real feelings?

Note: Includes an extra.

103211.description:
He's known as the Messiah, having brought countless men and women pleasure with his prodigious tongue skills. He's never been one to let another guy take him, until he crosses paths with a man claiming to have erectile dysfunction who tricks him into being the bottom! Ever since then, he can't seem to forget the ecstasy of that night, and to make things worse, the source of his troubles comes back for more...! In addition to the Messiah series, this collection includes the "Space Rhizomes" series about an old man with a beautiful, youthful appearance and his unruly (but a tad goofy) assistant who pour their blood, sweat and tears into developing adult toy technology, and the "Perverse Love" series. A "positive" world view exploding with light-hearted lust has been condensed into this long-awaited anthology!

(Source: Renta!)

1. Messiah no Kyoujitsu (メシアの凶日, The Messiah's Cursed Day)
2. Messiah no Sentaku (メシアの選択, The Messiah's Choice)

5. Henai Fumou-hen (変愛 不毛変, Perverse Love)
6. Uchuu no Mozuku!! (宇宙のもずく！！, Space Tentacles!!)

2. Good Excuse (グッドエクスキューズ) [Jaryuu Dokuro]

synonyms: Sakasa Moji nara Suki da to Ieru

103213.description:
Let's just say Jinwoo and Seyoung got off to a rocky start. Not knowing Seyoung would be living in a company dorm with a male employee, her direct superior at that, she barged into his room thinking it was hers. Her timing couldn't have been more inappropriate as Jinwoo was in the middle of his pleasure time. Embarrassed and nowhere to hide, Jinwoo's life was headed towards misery. However, little did he know Seyoung was no ordinary rookie. She had her own dirty little secret...

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: 新卒妄想ちゃんの日常性活！

103214.description:
The class representative, Saeki, uses an array of tactics to sleep during class. Tokimiya, the boy sitting next to her, tends to observe her different tactics and while doing so his interest begins to shift...

In other words, Saeki wants to sleep.

Note: Chapter count includes 9 extras.

103215.description:
Makie's a boy in love, with his tall, older classmate Sachi. As a sign of his affection, he makes Sachi a special lunch every day. Sachi loves Makie, too, but she has a secret... she's actually a shapeshifting monster called a watari, and she was drawn to Makie because he smells...delicious! But it's not just Sachi who's drawn to Makie's scent, and soon, he realizes the entire monster world is after him. Fortunately, Sachi's a watari who eats watari, and she pledges to protect him. But how long can Makie survive, with Sachi's appetite the only thing between him and a monster's belly?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Her Appetite's Too Big for Me Alone

title.native: あの人の胃には僕が足りない
title.romaji: Ano Hito no I ni wa Boku ga Tarinai

103216.description: During his high school years, Keita was slender and had feminine features, but he fell in love with Satoshi, an upperclassman who had the lean, masculine physique he dreamed of. Keita confessed and perhaps due to his beautiful, girly looks, they started going out. Three years later, their relationship is as strong as ever, and they currently live together like newlyweds. However, there was one big change...! Keita had matured into a manly guy! Because Satoshi used to be straight, Keita begins to wonder what his boyfriend thinks about the situation, even when they're having sex...

103217.description:
"So who's more popular: me or him!? He's supposed to be my enemy, but why are we touching each other like this!?"

Sano's ambition is to become the most popular guy at school, and have lots of female admirers. Except there's just one person who's getting in his way to achieve it... Kiyoharu Azuma has a bad reputation for being a player, but the girls are still attracted to this bad boy. What's worse is Sano finds the girl he's after with Kiyoharu, which makes him even more motivated to one up the guy. Upset that Kiyoharu's fooling around with a girl he doesn't even like, Sano tries to embarrass Kiyoharu. But Kiyoharu's letting out some serious sensual vibes, turning things into an unexpected situation. A story between a guy who wants to be popular and a guy who's born to be popular!

(Source: Renta!)

103219.description:
Maiko Fujimiya is a second-year high school student whose hobby is admiring girls' butts.She likes to stand at the bottom of the stairway closest to the female-only train and stare upwards. However, she doesn't adore all butts equally; her type is a big, sexy, plump ass. Fortunately, she has noticed a girl with the perfect butt riding on the same train as her. Moreover, she also gets off at the same station as Maiko. Still, Maiko is content with admirng that ass from afar and fantasising about it, but her life is about the change when the girl suddenly approaches her.

Included one-shot: Himitsu no Zettai Ryouiki (秘蜜の絶対領域)

title.native: 私のシュミってヘンですか?
title.romaji: Watashi no Shumitte Hen desu ka?

103220.description:
In the early 20th century, a small republic found itself stuck between a kingdom and an empire—both of whom wanted to manipulate the republic to suit their own needs.

In order to protect itself from both sides of the conflict, the republic created a small group of soldiers whose job it is to suppress revolution and dissent in any way possible. This is the story of the Opera House.
synonyms: Treason Agency: The Queen of the Opera

103225.description:
A waiter with a history of abusive boyfriends desperately searches for love until one day, he meets the artist behind one of his favorite sculptures. The final chapter is a one-shot about a male escort who says he has only one month left to live.

Note: Includes one extra chapter and the one-shot "Misshitsu Renai (密室恋愛)".
synonyms: Surely the Kiss of my Dreams

title.native: これはきっと夢の中のキス
title.romaji: Kore wa Kitto Yume no Naka no Kiss

103226.description: This spinoff manga was first serialized in Lupin III Official Magazine between 2004 and 2013.

103227.description: I couldn't kill my target because he's too cute, so I became his girlfriend instead.

title.native: ゾンビ少年と殺人鬼少女

103229.description:
An alluring and popular honor student who goes by the name of Mone. Steadfast and diligent, she only has one foreseeable flaw; her philosophy on love is utterly trash! But both her mind and her heart might be swayed sooner than she thinks in this school love manga.

Includes 9 bonus chapters.
synonyms: Mone-san's Overly Serious Way of Dating
萌音同学太过认真的交往方

title.native: モネさんのマジメすぎるつき合い方

103230.description:
17-year-old Fuuka “Puuka” Tabatake is a slow-rising model. On the way to a photoshoot in the dark woods, she and her manager hit a zombie with their car. In the middle of investigating, her manager is violently eaten and Puuka accidentally gets bitten by a self-proclaimed “good zombie”!

Now an undead herself, the good zombie Sukekiyo escorts her to the undead colony where he lives. Forced to reconsider her future and abandon those she knew, these are the unusual days of Puuka adjusting to being a zombie.

103231.description:
When the Miasma appeared, it devastated Japan. Killing humans and transforming animals into vicious monsters, the Miasma also became a limitless energy source for those who survived. Kenga Yuuki wants to become a monster hunter like Ryou, the hero who saved him when he was younger, but the obstacles he'll face in this quest are far greater than he could ever have imagined!

(Source: Mangamo)
synonyms: O Baile de Máscaras do Miasma

title.native: 瘴気のガスマスカレイド

103232.description:
Jaehyun may be the composed upperclassman on campus, but he secretly plays the hottest elven diva online with a love of pricey costumes. He meets Eunsung, a handsome first-year with deep pockets guarding his own secrets, at a school event. They connect instantly, but what begins as a sweet challenge becomes a risky game of affection on- and offline!

(Source: Tappytoon)

103233.description:
1. Slow Days
2. Start Line
3. Hanashi wo Shinagara
4. Stargazer
5. Toritome no Nai Koi no Uta (The Rambling Love Poem)
6. Kaze no Sukima
7. Ano Hakoniwa
8. Kawaikunai wa Seigi!
9. Toki ni wa Mukashi no Hanashi wo

103234.description:
Once upon a time in the small town of Hiraya, Nagano Prefecture, lived a normal high schooler named Seta Rinichirou.

One stormy night, he found a Princess named Polilyfa and the Female Knight (Valkyrie) who served her, Krauzera, collapsed in the middle of paddy field. Both of them had escaped from their country who fell to Orc army attack using Gate magic. And now they established a government in exile at Rinichirou house.

Between jealous stalker childhood friend, Princess Pau and Krauzera fascination at Japanese modern technology and culture, and superdense Rinichirounium, a slapstick comedy choked with otaku culture reference in a rural Nagano countryside will begin! Also, the people from this world and from that world began to visit one after another.
synonyms: Why not go to JUSCO with me Valkyrie? -Refugee government series-

title.native: 女騎士さん、ジャスコ行こうよ

103235.description: Out of nowhere, 99 girls were sent to a large room, where they are inadvertently transferred to the other side of the screen. There, strange creatures live, which begin to hunt the girls who cross the monitor.

103236.description: The story drags us into the daily life of Mashiro, a handywoman, who takes care of helping the people of the village. One day, the Domineita Empire invades the region and captures all the women to make them their slaves. When her friend dies before her eyes, Mashiro, mad with anger, manages to wake up the millennial robot who was secretly residing in the village. It is now her chance to stop the thirst for uncontrollable power of the Domineita Empire. Soon, she is joined by other mecha pilots in this crazy quest to oppose an entire Empire.

103238.description:
After dying in the act of stopping a crime in modern Japan, our hero is reincarnated as Cain von Silford, third son of a noble family in a world of swords and sorcery. In his new life, all children receive a blessing from the gods…but Cain is unexpectedly blessed with an absolutely enormous, over-the-top cornucopia of magical powers. If his dream of traveling the world as a free spirit is to come true, he can’t reveal too much of his potential to the wrong people. A light-hearted, escapist adventure in another world begins!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: เกิดใหม่เป็นขุนนางไปผจญภัยในต่างโลก: อัครทูตจอมซุ่มซ่ามของทวยเทพ

title.english: Chronicles of an Aristocrat Reborn in Another World
title.native: 転生貴族の異世界冒険録 ～自重を知らない神々の使徒～
title.romaji: Tensei Kizoku no Isekai Boukenroku: Jichou wo Shiranai Kamigami no Shito

103239.description:
"The only time I will be meek and willing with this man... is when we're in bed."

Her first impression of him is that he is the worst. Uncaring, attached, and completely not worth her consideration, until... Misao Narita is a fresh graduate and brand new office worker, who absolutely hates her superior at work. His name is Ichikawa. He is extremely tall and always has a dark look in his eyes. And yet...?! Due to an accident, they end up as friends with benefits. A purely physical attraction, it is completely different from the ideal romance that she had in mind. She knows they should stop, but somehow, they can't!

(Source: Pocket Comics)

103240.description:
"Please let me off, CEO!" The seductive bar singer in his embrace, is the bespectacled boy who had a one-sided love with him for years. He wouldn't want to meet this boy again, but this boy became his assistant on the second day?! He felt ridiculed... This boy in disguise, is it to avoid an old flame, or some other reason?

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Includes 7 extras.

103241.description: After a long time spent in the United States, where he learned archery, Kazuma Amakusa returned to Japan. He joined the Seibu academy, but there, lacking a dedicated club or a dojo where he could train, he was content to continue this sport he loved so much in secret.

title.native: 青武高校あおぞら弓道部

103242.description: Shota Kanda, has returned to his hometown when he was a child after entering high school.and is with Sanae Kondo, who was a childhood friend of his when he was in kindergarten, but she was just like a child. At the same time he met Kana Funami, who was close to him and Ms. Hayana a tsundere who is out of control.

title.native: ポンコツンデレな幼馴染

103244.description: A kiss in the summer changes the relationship between two childhood friends.

103245.description:
Miyuki Sanada had just been going through the motions until one night she came across a certain late-night anime that made her feel true passion for the first time in her life. She was so impressed by the production that she decided to become an animator herself! But was that really such a good idea? Harsh lessons and even harsher financial realities await as Miyuki strives to make her dream come true.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

103246.description:
On her deathbed, a sickly young girl wishes to be reborn with a strong body that will never succumb to anyone or anything. Lo and behold, her wish is granted! Upon reincarnating into another world as Mary Regalia, she discovers her new body has maxed-out attributes, from physical strength, to defense, and even magic. But wait! That isn't what she really wanted! All she longed for was a normal life...but that's a tall order when you're absolutely invincible!

Join Mary as she navigates her new life as a duke's daughter, makes friends of all stripes—including her devoted maid, an irreverent trainee knight, a proud magician girl, and even the prince of the kingdom—fights off terrifying monsters, and maybe even gets mistaken for a knight of legend!

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: It Seems My Body Is Completely Invincible
看來我的身體天下無敵呢

title.native: どうやら私の身体は完全無敵のようですね
title.romaji: Douyara Watashi no Karada wa Kanzen Muteki no You desu ne

103247.description:
Myojin was once a cursed child who managed to work his way up to being a God of the Celestial Realm. For the sin of killing his fellow celestial beings, he was cast down to Earth to live -- and, eventually, die -- among humans.

But the wheels of fate turn in the oddest of ways, for one day the baby son of a celestial deity and mortal man ends up falling into Myojin's custody. Believing that showing kindness to the child will help him be accepted back into the Celestial Realm, Myojin takes him in. But can this man, whose heart has become hardened towards both suffering and joy, rear a healthy, wholesome child?

103248.description: Little girls that are also elves do lewd things as part of a harem

title.native: 元勇者はロリエルフ村をハーレムにデキました！
title.romaji: Moto Yuusha wa Loli Elf Mura wo Harem ni Dekimashita!

103250.description:
One day, penguins are spotted in the suburban town that fourth-grader Aoyama calls home. The penguins make their sudden appearance in a residential district—nowhere near the ocean—and disappear just as mysteriously. Where could they have come from, and where did they go? Aoyama is determined to get to the bottom of it! This is the slightly curious, unforgettable tale of that summer.

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: ペンギン・ハイウェイ

103251.description:
"Tonight, we're going to kill Mifuyu's father."

To save their best friend from domestic violence, Nao Nanba and two of her classmates plan the murder of Mifuyu's abusive father. They thought they had pulled off the perfect crime and finally put an end to their best friend's hellish days, until... When "secrets" between girls are revealed, good, bad, and ugly, their beautiful friendship quietly crumbles.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

103252.description:
Several one-shots created by the team behind Shokugeki no Souma for various celebrations and anniversaries of One Piece.

Follow Sanji's tales of cooking up meals and adventuring through the Grand Line with the Straw Hat Pirates!

103253.description:
The apocalypse is not only near, but a certainty. Set before the event and the aftermath detailed by the hit manga, this stand-alone prequel light novel series chronicles the inexorable approach of the reign of vampires. Witness the trials of Guren Ichinose, who must hide his true strength even as he is trampled on at an academy for the insufferably privileged.

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: Seraph Of The End: Guren Ichinose, Catástrofe A Los dieciséis
Seraph of the end: Guren Ichinose, catástrofe a los 16

title.english: Seraph of the End: Guren Ichinose: Catastrophe at Sixteen
title.native: 終わりのセラフ 一瀬グレン、16歳の破滅
title.romaji: Owari no Seraph: Ichinose Guren, 16-sai no Catastrophe

103255.description:
Natsu, Lucy, Happy, Erza, and the whole Fairy Tail Guild are back in action! And they’ve decided to tackle the “100 Years Quest”—a job no one’s dared take on since the founding of the guild more than a century ago. A mysterious town, a baffling spirit, a ghastly new enemy … and a brand new continent to explore. When you’re with real friends, the adventures never stop!

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: FAIRY TAIL魔導少年 百年任務

103257.description:
Based on an otome game from Otomate. 

“Airi” had been living her normal, peaceful life in the White World. “Luna” had been ruling the Black World as the Queen. One day, a coup d’etat rose in the Black World and the two girls were swapped-- Airi to the Black World, and Luna to the White World

What is the secret that lies behind these worlds and what underlying connection binds Airi and Luna--?

103259.description: Momoko is just a normal waitress who works at a cafe, but suddenly a fateful romance appears right in front of her....

103260.description:
Aimu Yuu is a boy who just moved into the equivalent of a boarding house.
Everything is not as it first seems, even the boy. Living in the same room is a ghost (female) named Mii. The series is a combination of love, humour, and a general parody of anime and manga. There are a lot of weird characters in this manga.

103261.description: The story of two small-town high school boys and best friends, both striving to escape from their suffocating lives in the close-minded hamlet.
synonyms: Across the Ocean to the Far Side of the Moon

title.romaji: Umi no Mukou, Tsuki no Uragawa

103262.description:
The world is big and contains countless mysteries. The human realm will always have many varieties of terrifying and abnormal happenings; perhaps in the past, the present, and the future.

A collection of short thriller stories that will blow your mind.

103263.description: Noa Kagura is a cross-dresser who gets asked out by Shinobu Takada, a boyish girl on their school's karate team.
synonyms: A Romcom with a Girly Guy and a Boyish Girl
Onnanoko-kun to Otoko-chan no Love Comedy

title.native: 女男くんと男女さんのラブコメ
title.romaji: Onnanoko-kun to Otoko-chan no Love Kome

103264.description:
In the 21st century when Da Vinci’s doctrine of aestheticism has become widespread, a young man dreams of becoming a detective. When a beautiful new transfer student arrives, he suspects she may be a thief come to steal all of Da Vinci’s discoveries despite the loveliness of her face! The battle between a high school girl criminal mastermind and bloodhound detective has just begun!

(Source: Tokyo Otaku Mode)

103265.description: In this short series by the master Matsumoto Leiji, we have the tale of Eve, a beautiful woman who has literally fallen to Earth in her spacecraft. Where did she come from, and why is she here?

103266.description: Manga centers around two officers in the police's mobile investigation team: Shinobu Satomi and Yuki Inokuma. The two are partners and also lovers. At the site of a bizarre murder, they meet Kara Tachibana, a mysterious and beautiful woman, and from there, her derangement begins to derail their investigation.

103267.description:
Following the Heath Oslo incident, the existence of the US-Japanese anti-terror organization CIRS has become a matter of public knowledge. CIRS has been rebuilt from the ground up, and its most covert functions spun off to a new agency: SORD (Social Ops, Research & Development).

The goal of SORD is to train a new generation of operatives to defend the country against future threats. To that end, the organization has established a series of schools up and down the country. Mihama Academy, more-or-less left to rot after its abrupt closure, has been given new purpose as one such 'specialist training school'.

This new incarnation of Mihama Academy is home to a diverse group of students, who every day work to polish their unusual skills - sometimes on the job. Mihama now entrusts the misfit girls who attend it with guns and live ammunition. Paying their own safety no heed, these students are again and again plunged into dangerous extrajudicial missions - all for the good of the realm.

(Source: Frontwing)

title.native: グリザイア：ファントムトリガー　世界の果て
title.romaji: Grisaia: Phantom Trigger - Sekai no Hate

103268.description: Circa, who had always failed in his summoning classes, accidentally summoned... Bisnuth, the king of fire! Bisnuth who was angry at being summoned suddenly, and the clueless circa who got enamoured with him... this is a couple's love story which is thicker than blood and hotter than fire.
synonyms: A Song of Blood and Fire

103269.description:
Mami is 36 and unmarried, and the entire world seems to be telling her she must be miserable. But is she? Does she really need a ring on her finger to be happy when she has a job she loves and friends who support her? A collection of interconnected stories that explores the hazards and joys of unmarried life through the eyes of three single ladies.

(Source: VIZ Media)

title.native: ずっと独身でいるつもり?

103270.description:
Eating around other people is a struggle for salaryman Yutaka, despite his talent for cooking. All that changes when he meets Minoru and Tane—two brothers, many years apart in age—who ask him to teach them how to make his delicious food! Yutaka soon finds himself having a change of heart as he looks forward to the meals they share together.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

103271.description: A secret experiment is being conducted in the renowned elite university of Ooyashima. A very simple experiment - certain students only need to create the instrument called SCM. But this instrument is a terrible device that can turn others into slaves!
synonyms: Giant Slave Ward: You and 130 Million Slaves

title.native: 大奴隷区 君と1億3千万の奴隷

103272.description:
When she stands, she's like a white peony. When she sits, she's like a tree peony. When she walks, she's like a lily flower. And when you look her in the eyes, she's like the Great King of Terror. Despite having the qualities to be a peerless bishoujo, because of the look of her eyes and that atmosphere of hers, she's feared by others; such a girl is forcefully sent to another world. Being told by an Evil God that she would be granted a wish as a special favor, the girl made a wish──

"Make my eyes and atmosphere normal please."

This is a story recounting the lifestyle in a parallel world of a girl who would be perfect (probably) if just her one weak point was overcome.

A fantasy comedy with magic, dungeons, and a hero and a demon king(candidate) who she gets tangled up with.

She's cursed though.

(Source: Oniichanyamete)

103273.description: The hero is a Ronin who is undertaking an embarrassing job search when he is killed in an unfortunate accident. When he wakes up, he has been re-incarnated into a new world. "I'll never live a lazy life again." He tries to restart his new life with such determination. He is born to a fallen noble. How on earth will he manage? This is the story of a young man and his partner's struggles to save his home from downfall.

title.native: ディンの紋章 ～魔法師レジスの転生譚～
title.romaji: Din no Monshou: Mahoushi Regis no Tenseitan

103274.description: Shiratama works as a professor at a university in Tokyo - and he has a secret. The thing is, he brings his kitten to work with him. What's more is that the kitten can talk! A relaxing college comedy about the talking kitten and the adults around him!

103279.description:
A girl who was bullied and ready to give up everything.
A boy who never knew fun because of his circumstances. Until the night of the first snow.
Somehow they met again in a night-time school. 
"The day you taught me that I'm not alone, I decided I'd face forward and live on."

103280.description:
Host x Dentist!
"What kind of face is this guy making under that mask?"

103281.description: Chigusa lives alone following the death of his wife, trapped in a monotonous cycle of work, dinner, sleep, work... Until one rainy day, when he rescues an odd little ball of fluff from the roadside and takes it home.

103282.description:
Burned out by city life, Yoshito Ogami starts farming in the country. He enjoys his life with Ume, the cute puppy his neighbor gave him, until one day, a boy shows up in his place ? with an animal's ears and tail! "You're going to be my female," he says, and proceeds to pounce on Yoshito and plant his seed...! Also included are steamy stories about Yoshito's son and a guy whose brother attaches a belt to his private parts to keep him all to himself!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: There's a Wolf in My Bed
title.native: オオカミさんとえろいこと

103283.description:
A new installment in the long-running "Lupin III" series! Arsène Lupin III, the world's greatest thief (or maybe just the world's goofiest thief) foils his rivals and pulls off insane heists with his oddball crew of professional crooks: gunman Jigen Daisuke, samurai Goemon Ishikawa XIII, and femme fatale Mine Fujiko.

(Source: Japanese Publisher, translated)
synonyms: Lupin Sansei T - Gyakuten Chaser Hen
ルパン三世T デッドマン オークション編
ルパン三世T 逆転チェイサー編
ルパン三世T どっちが勝つか三代目VS十三代目編

103284.description:
A spin-off manga which mostly contains adaptation of Lupin III media from pachinko, TV series, games and light novels. Only one chapter has an original story.

It was created by Naoya Hayakawa, supervised by TMS Entertainment and it was first serialized in Lupin III Official Magazine from 2009 to 2015. Nine volumes, which compiled all the chapters, have been released by Futabasha between October 2010 and February 2016.

Unlike the other derivative works where illustrators did their own take, Lupin III H is inspired by the anime with character designs taking cues mostly from Lupin the 3rd Part 1 and Part 2.
synonyms: Lupin Sansei H - Lupin wa Moete Iru ka....?! Hen
ルパン三世H World is mine 編
ルパン三世H さらば愛しき魔女編
ルパン三世H ルパンは燃えているか・・・・?!編
ルパン三世H 大泥棒VS女怪盗
ルパン三世H 星を盗む男編
ルパン三世H 華麗なる挑戦編

103286.description:
Chi is back! Manga’s most famous cat returns with a brand new series! Chi’s Sweet Adventures collects dozens of new full-color kitty tales made for readers of all ages!

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: Nhật kí tung tăng của Chi
Süße Katze Chi: Chi's Sweet Adventures

103287.description:
Known as the "Prince Among Shamans," Yohan is famous for his supernatural second sight. But in reality, he uses social media to collect info on his clients as his personal spirit, Donga, is too lazy to help! One day, the CEO of a successful IT venture firm visits Yohan's shop, trailed by a powerful spirit! An unlikely romance takes flight, as Yohan tries to help this CEO come to terms with his otherworldly friend.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Chapter count includes 93 regular chapters, prologue and 12 side story extras The side stories are R19.
synonyms: เจ้าชายร่างทรง

103288.description: Side stories featuring the two protagonists of Shuuten Unknown.

103289.description:
Six former classmates meet at their high school reunion: legal secretary Tamaki, businessman Takumi, single mother Yuka, shoe salesman Taichi, tech CEO Shoji, and teacher Moé. As their conversation turns to long-ago loves lost, Yuka makes a shocking confession: in the summer of their second year, she lied to keep Tamaki and Takumi from getting together! After a night of drinking and reminiscence, Tamaki awakens to find herself ten years in the past, on the day that fateful summer began. But just as she learns Takumi has returned to the past as well, they both receive a mysterious text message … Those life-changing summer days have come around again, but can the past truly be changed?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

103290.description: Umineko no Naku Koro ni Shi: Forgery of the Purple Logic is a manga-exclusive series by Kurumi Suzuhiro. The story expands on the use of the purple declaration introduced by Bernkastel in Twilight of the Golden Witch. The red truth still applies in this game even though there are lesser than usual games. Knox's rules are stated in red to show that it is valid in this game. The story takes place outside the main story.

title.native: うみねこのなく頃に 紫 Forgery of the Purple logic
title.romaji: Umineko no Naku Koro ni Murasaki: Forgery of the Purple logic

103291.description:
"Auntie Yuriko's run away to be with her lover!? Could this be the chance I've been waiting for!?" Misato plans to use this opportunity to get close to her beloved uncle, until her ulterior motives are discovered by gruff detective Kazuma Saeki, who has been hired to work on the case. He treats her like a kid and ruins all her plans... even going so far as XXX...!! Will Misato find a clue to unravel the mystery of adult romance!?

(Source: Renta!)

103292.description:
1. Aigan Cinderella (Pampered Cinderella):
It was the worst day for Kawasumi Wakaba. She just got fired from her job and her former boyfriend was cheating on her and he got to keep the condo! What's worse is that after a night of heavy drinking she wakes up and a total hottie-who-must-be-a-celebrity tells her that she's now his sexy work maid!

2. Koi wa Honoo no You ni (Love is Like a Fire):
Hina is madly in love with her firefighter boyfriend, Ryuuji. But when her friend asks her if she's afraid of him ever getting hurt and never coming home some day, Hina starts to feel insecure. What's worse is that a male co-worker notices and decides to take advantage of the situation!

3. Kaikan Travel (Pleasant Travel):
Kana and her boyfriend, Hiroto, finally got to go on vacation. But while Kana thought Hiroto would spend time with her, he gets a call from work and completely ignores her! Frustrated Kana meets up with her new friend Lisa and her boyfriend only to be dragged into something “fun”.

4. Yabai Koi wa Kimi no Tonari (A Dangerous Love is Next to You):
Aya's childhood friend, Keiji, has always been rude and mean to her. When Aya finally gets a boyfriend, Keiji personally interferes!

103293.description:
Choko starts to have a friends with benefit relationship with her High School crush Kazuki. She is now 36 years old, twice divorced and has a teenager daughter who she raises on her own.
Kazuki works as a doctor in a lady's clinic and also doesn't want to marry or have a deeper relationsip.

They agree to just sleep with each other when one of them wants to do it. But of course, there are still feelings and other drama trying to break this promise.

title.native: セフレの品格―プライド―

103294.description:
A heroic and mighty adventurer dreams of...opening a pharmacy?
Red was once a member of the Hero's party, a powerful group destined to save the world from the evil forces of Taraxon, the Raging Demon Lord. That is, until one of his comrades kicked him out. Hoping to live the easy life on the frontier, Red's new goal is to open an apothecary. However, keeping the secret of his former life may not be as simple as he thinks. Especially when the beautiful Rit, an adventurer from his past, shows up and asks to move in with him!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: I Was Kicked out of the Hero’s Party Because I Wasn’t a True Companion so I Decided to Have a Slow Life at the Frontier
Banished from the brave man's group, I decided to lead a slow life in the back country.
因為不是真正的夥伴而被逐出勇者隊伍，流落到邊境展開慢活人生

title.english: Banished from the Hero's Party, I Decided to Live a Quiet Life in the Countryside
title.native: 真の仲間じゃないと勇者のパーティーを追い出されたので、辺境でスローライフすることにしました
title.romaji: Shin no Nakama ja Nai to Yuusha no Party wo Oidasareta node, Henkyou de Slow Life Suru Koto ni Shimashita

103295.description:
After her boyfriend cheats on her, Luo Yaoyao lets loose, gets drunk at a bar... and makes a move on the king of the underworld after mistaking him for a simple male host. Shoot -- she had better run quick! But could running away really be that easy? Dream on! Two years later, she takes a temporary job at China's number one company. And little does she know that her nightmare is just getting started...

(Source: Webnovel)

103298.description: Novel that focuses on Kagari Shuusei.
synonyms: Psycho-Pass Legend: The Pursuer Kagari Shuusei

title.native: PSYCHO-PASS LEGEND 追跡者 縢秀星

103300.description:
After his father’s death, Raymond seeks to find out more about his father’s work with werewolves, much of which was completed in secrecy. So he enters the Central Laboratory and meets Kata, the werewolf his father discovered years ago. He is one of three werewolves in the entire world to have been discovered by science. But Kata is a special specimen... in order for the laboratory to get the most out of their research, all of Kata’s needs must be met – including his voracious sexual appetite. Life at the lab has a long history of mixing work with pleasure, and it isn’t long until the lives of everyone at the Central Laboratory becomes tangled up with one another.

(Source: Lezhin)

title.native: ましゅまろ×タイフーンッ

103305.description:
1-6. Shoujo Konkatsu Jidai
7. Kawaranai Mono
8. Kagachi-sama
9. Boku to Sennin-sama

103306.description:
Zoshigaya. Gotanda. Kinshicho. Komazawa Daigaku. Nakano. These should be your most desirable places to live. The Shigeta Twins run a real estate agency in Kichijoji and keep complaining about the changes the area is going through. However, their office is highly sought after by young ladies who believe the hype that Kichijoji is the coolest place to live! That’s why, today, they will introduce you to some great under-the-radar neighborhoods other than Kichijoji.

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: Is Kichijouji the Only Place Where You Want to Live?

title.english: Is Kichijoji the Only Place to Live?
title.native: 吉祥寺だけが住みたい街ですか？
title.romaji: Kichijouji dake ga Sumitai Machi desu ka?

103307.description: The manga follows the adventures of a Pokémon Trainer, Akira, and his Rockruff. This manga loosely follows the events of the video game Pokémon Sun and Moon, and was created by Tenya Yabuno.

title.native: ポケットモンスター ホライズン

103308.description:
There was once a hero who was summoned to another world, and he saved that world. However, the man was caught in a "trap" and was forcibly returned to his original world. On top of that, he had to start over as a baby… This is the story of a crazy journey in another world where a former hero who was reincarnated into a slightly gloomy high school student is "resummoned" back to that same world! There's a lot of room to work with when it's the second time, huh♪

(Source: Coolmic)
synonyms: A Second Time for an Otherworld Summoning

title.native: 異世界召喚は二度目です

103309.description:
A story about older girls who really love food and booze.

Note: Includes 56 extras chapters.

title.native: アイドルマスター シンデレラガールズ After20

103310.description: In a not so distant future it's become a fashion boom to attach ears. This spring, after having become a high school student, Midorino Nono has finally convinced her parents to let her have her sought after Attached ears debut♪ However, a powerful unique effect happens~ A huge disaster! When she has rabbit ears attached, she gets taken over by their sexual desire and becomes very ecchi!? Mikan of the ear attaching shop, and Nono's desired Neon-chan who is also Mikan's childhood friend get caught up in this, and the curtain on Nono's crazy attached ear life is raised!!

title.native: 発情スイッチ ～堕とされた少女達～

103552.description:
1-3) Haru wa Watashi wo Baka ni Suru (春は私をバカにする)
A lonely, troublesome boy who does whatever he wants; an uncontrollable playboy... But, Nao is "friends" which Sasaki Shun, who is like this...?!

4) Kimi wa Kuroi Hito. (君は黒いヒト。)
5) Kiss dake ja, Tarinai (キスだけじゃ、たりない)

Includes a bonus story.
synonyms: Der Frühling macht mich ganz verrückt

title.romaji: Haru wa Watashi wo Baka ni Suru

103553.description: When high school student Mikoto Shirakawa receives her first ever love confession, she's ecstatic!  Makoto Ootsuki isn't exactly her type, but without thinking much about it, she accepts him, delighted that she can finally brag to her friends about having a boyfriend. But little does she know that her new boyfriend is no ordinary guy. It turns out that dating someone you don't know can be complicated, especially when they turn out to have a twisted personality! A perverted love story about paraphilia begins!
103553.hashtag: #嫌がってるキミが好き #イヤキミ
synonyms: I Like You with That Look of Repulsion

title.native: 嫌がってるキミが好き

103554.description:
Satoshi Osako, 40, had just defeated the final boss of a video game when an unexpected accident brought his life to an end. But when he opens his eyes again, he finds himself reincarnated in another world...with all of his stats intact!

Seeking nothing more than a peaceful life, this middle-aged man begins his journey through a fantasy world... but will tranquility really be so easy to find?

(Source: Kadokawa)
synonyms: Around 40 Kenja no Isekai Seikatsu Nikki

title.english: The Diary of a Middle-Aged Sage's Carefree Life in Another World
title.native: アラフォー賢者の異世界生活日記
title.romaji: Arafou Kenja no Isekai Seikatsu Nikki

103556.description: When J’s servant accidentally breaks one of the bottles that holds the villains from his tales, Sera—the priest from “The Little Match Girl”—is set free from his confinement. What will he learn about J’s reasons for story-telling?

title.native: えろ◆めるへん 黒の章

103557.description:
Based on the Dragon's Dogma video game; the manga series is about the adventures of the Arisen Karol and his main pawn Elise.

Karol's simple life as a fisherman changed when his home village of Cassardis was attacked by a dragon, who then proceeds to consume his heart, marking him as the Arisen. Now he seeks to reclaim his heart and along the way, he learns more of what truly makes an Arisen and of the mysterious Pawn Legion.

title.native: ドラゴンズドグマプログレス

103558.description:
“I’ll do whatever you want so experience as much as you want!”

Joon-shik, a contracted librarian, has given up on dating women because of an accumulated disappointment towards the women who have left him due to his job title.

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

103559.description:
The "soothing short" manga follows Chitose, a fluffy Emperor penguin chick living in Kyoto. The stories depict such familiar Kyoto locales as Togetsu-kyō bridge, Arashiyama Bamboo Grove, Fushimi Inari-taisha shrine, and Kiyomizu-dera temple from a penguin's perspective, as well as Kyoto cuisine.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: おこしやす、ちとせちゃん

103560.description: Ueno Ittou is a kind and tall high school student raised by a single mom. One day when he gets home he finds an empty house and no signs of his mother, she has left him... In that moment, a mysterious girl offers him a job with upfront payment. The job is to take care of the Josei manga author, Nobara Hifumi!
synonyms: ダメなカノジョは甘えたい

title.native: ダメな彼女は甘えたい

103562.description: Yae and Chitose have been dating for one year. Their relationship continues in this sweet and fluffy slice-of-life story.

103563.description: A brief story about finding a purpose in life, and working singlemindedly to achieve it...

103564.description:
Official anthology of the popular yuri manga Citrus. A collection of 17 oneshots.

Story 1 : be careful not to play games to much (Eku Takeshima)
Story 2: ear-nimal pandemic (Neji)
Story 3: the things i want to watch with you (Kayako)

Story 12: M.I.B. Mei in black (kurauko)
Story 13 : two sisters (Mako Takahashi)
Story 14 dead or love (kino kiyuki)
Story 15: Hathews (yuki yukio)
Story 16 : have a bite (fujieda)
Story 17 : wait for sleep… (yayoi osawa)

title.native: citrus コミックアンソロジー

103565.description: “Mikazuchi Dorm” a dorm where the male students live. Sagara never had a problem finding a partner, but for the first time had his heart broken. As it was hard for him to stay at the dorms, he ventures to his childhood friend, Hibiki’s Dorm instead. But as Sagara realized Hibiki looked like the vice dorm leader when he wears his glasses, he asked him to “comfort me” as a joke. To his surprise, Hibiki agrees. Drunk in Hibiki’s erotic expressions, they have sex. After, Hibiki actually confesses to him, saying he's always loved him…!?

103566.description:
Continuation of Migi ka Hidari ka, which was included in Futari no Netsuryou.
Takamune Houjou and Minami have been good friends for twenty years. After certain events happened, the two are now finally officially lovers. However, the biggest issue they have with their relationship is...that they don't know who will top who!! So now its an all out match to see who "wins or loses"!!

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Raz na dole, raz na górze

103567.description: Kouhei transfers from the city to a port town on a small island and ends up becoming fast friends with an outgoing guy named Yuuta. One day, Yuuta overhears someone confessing their love to Kouhei, and through this discovers that his friend already has someone he likes...

103568.description: Sachi befriends Julia at one of his photoshoots while he’s in college. At another of Sachi’s photoshoots, Julia, who follows Sachi like a dog, is spotted and becomes a supermodel while Sachi doesn’t. Instead, Sachi becomes a working adult within the same industry.

103569.description:
Collections of one-shots each selected by 85 different shoujo manga authors and organized by theme:

Volume 1 - Love Story (恋愛)
1. Biidama no Hashi (ビー玉の橋) [Robico] [Selected by Saki Haruki]
2. Haruaki Hime (春秋姫) [Yukiko Kai] [Selected by Aiko Itou]

4. Koibumi Biyori "Atashi wo Shiranai Kimi e" (恋文日和＜あたしをしらないキミへ＞) [George Asakura] [Selected by Machiko Sakurai]
5. Romantical Blue Illumination (ロマンティカル・ブルー・イルミネーション) [Hiromu Ono] [Selected by herself]

7. Michikusa (みちくさ) [Kyouko Fumizuki] [Selected by Chieko Hara]

2. 50-nen no Toki wo Koete (50年の時を超えて) [Mariko Takeda] [Selected by herself]
3. Moderato Cantabile (モデラートカンタービレ) [Noriko Nakayama] [Selected by herself]
4. Kiseki no Okurimono (奇跡の贈りもの) [Rina Morino] [Selected by herself]
5. Hareta Hi wa Gakkou wo Yasunde (はれた日は学校をやすんで) [Rieko Saibara] [Selected by Nami Akimoto]
6. Barairo ga Me ni Shimiru (バラ色が目にしみる) [Yoshida Mayumi] [Selected by herself]
7. Sora no Kotori (空の小鳥) [Chica Umino] [Selected by Saki Aoi]
