Now, she's committed to being a full-time housewife trying to find ways to make her husband go 'doki doki' over her. Except, he keeps beating her at her own game! Get ready for the heart-clutching adorableness with these two newlyweds.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

103610.description:
Makoto has long been ostracized because of his odd hobbies and a sexual kink others would see as disgusting. One day he finds a book on summoning demons and manages to summon the intimidatingly beautiful and rather chatty Archduke J. The demon offers to grant Makoto’s deepest twisted desire in exchange for his life. Once Makoto has sated his demented appetites, he fulfills his end of the bargain, only to find he’s been reborn as a monster…in hell!

(Source: SuBLime)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

103612.description:
The story of a two-person shogi club: the senpai is obsessed with shogi and making her expressionless kouhai confess.

Note: The author didn't plan to continue the manga at first, but he decided to continue it. Since he draws the manga in his free time, the update schedule is not stable.
synonyms: The story of Senpai and Kouhai in Shogi Club

103613.description:
The creature known as man is quick to misunderstand.
The same applies to the the pure middle-schooler Yokoyama-kun: A diligent fellow who does his infirmary duty properly. "You're so nice. Thank you." The one to say that to him was his classmate Nishino-san, so Yokoyama-kun ended up thinking: ("Isn't she only nice to me?!" )
He couldn't help but be hopeful. ("Does she like me?!" )

This is the start of the misleading life between the fantasizing Yokoyama-kun and the equivocator Nishino-san.

title.native: コイツ, 俺のこと好きなのか?!
title.romaji: Koitsu, Ore no Koto Suki nano ka?!

103614.description: A sweet story of a tomboy girl who realizes that she can be attractive and find love like any other girl.

103615.description:
The enthusiastic Suhyeon was the first one to approach Ai, who was shy around strangers, and they became friends fast. One day, Suhyeon confessed his romantic feelings to his friend, but Ai ran away. When Suhyeon tried to stop him, he got into an accident…

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

103616.description:
Our protagonist, Shen Jun, is the lead singer and guitarist of the band Triumph of William, who fails to be cool at the very beginning. Another protagonist, Yu Zhixing, a little-known painter, is obsessed with his neighbor Shen Jun, but unfortunately, has nohas no chance to interact with himafraid to interaction with him. As he tries everything to talk to his neighbor, there it is, Shen Jun's cat is outside of his door?! He finally finds an excuse to talk to Shen Jun?

(Source: Webnovel)

103617.description:
So tell me what's the exact connection between you self-proclaimed Soloman's descendant and me, a normal college student? Don't explain something fiction-like to me, please. Wait, wait, wait. You have been my classmate for a year and I don't even know you? How could that be? And what's the red stamp on my neck? I have so many questions... OK first, why my roommate wants to kill me now?!

(Source: WebComics)

103618.description:
The main character, Rosa, is the child of the devil. Although her appearance is patently innocuous, the terrible things that befall everyone around her soon prove that she is anything but.

A dark, gruesome story, made all the more eerie by the sparkly, feminine 1960s shoujo art style Watanabe continues to use.

103619.description:
A collection of one-shots.

1. Hell Mother (ヘル・マザー)
2. House (ハウス)
3. Kagami yo Kagami (鏡よ鏡; Mirror Mirror)
4. Kowai Yume (こわい夢; Nightmare)
5. Fusuma (襖; Half-Open Door)

103620.description:
This charming new manga follows the father and daughter of the Sugisaki household, with its vain, gorgeous, and very doting father, and his equally stylish, cool, but far drier daughter - but can two different generations of shoujo main characters inhabit the same house?

Note: Includes 5 extra chapters.
synonyms: A Sugar-Sweet Dad and A Salty-Sour Daughter

title.native: シュガーなパパとソルトな娘
title.romaji: Sugar na Papa to Salt na Musume

103621.description: A screwball ecchi romantic comedy about a young potential mangaka dealing with his assistants who are sisters as they are madly in love with him.

title.native: 早乙女姉妹は漫画のためなら!?
title.romaji: Saotome Shimai wa Manga no Tame Nara!?

103622.description: Sasaki Rena is a beautiful woman with excellent memory and intelligence. She becomes a private detective and risks her life to chase down evil private detectives, because her younger sister was murdered by a stalker. The person that provided information to the stalker on her sister's location was a private detective.

103624.description:
A collection of horror and supernatural-themed oneshots.

1. Boku no Tamasshii (ぼくのタマッシー)
2. Furuya no Shimi (古屋の染み)
3. Kanojo no Suitcase (彼女のスーツケース)
4. Watashi no Tomodachi (私の友達)
5. Ame no Yoru no Koureisai (雨の夜の降霊祭)
6. Koi no Bourei (恋の亡霊)
7. Tawarebito (囚われ人)
8. Doukyuusei (同級生)
9. Kyuuyuu (旧友)
10. Shitai to Kurasu na Kodomotachi (死体と暮らすな子供たち)

103625.description: A one-shot prequel to the movie Two Heroes, featuring a young All Might, David Shield, and Melissa Shield.
synonyms: Everyone is a Hero to Someone

title.native: きっと誰もが誰かのヒーロー
title.romaji: Kitto Daremo ga Dareka no Hero

103626.description:
“R“ or rather Room 402 is the room where our illustrious female main character lives. One day which seems to be by mere coincidence her fate intertwines with that of Sasamoto, a savvy man who seems to be down in the dumps. That is until he picks up a trinket which fell from her nether regions. Prepare yourself for a story of sexual psychological horror as Sasamoto enters into a brave new world.

(Source: Chillock)

103628.description:
Kentarou Aizawa is a normal high school student who finds it strange that his things are going missing. One day,he catches someone suspiciously sneaking up to his locker, and it was his plain and quiet classmate Ikeda! When Ikeda desperately begs "Please, just let me keep stalking you!" while on his hands and knees, Kentarou can't say no...?

(Source: Tokyo Mangasha, translated)

Included one-shots:
Hanamuke no Uta wo, (はなむけのうたを、); Cab vol.37
Mijikai Tsuugakuro (短い通学路); Cab vol.38

Contains an extra story "another take".

title.native: 僕のかわいいストーカー

103629.description:
Asuka is your almost typical teenage girl. She studies hard in school, gossips with her friends, and does her chores. The one thing that makes her different from everyone else is her crush. She's in love with someone close to her. Her mother.

(Source: Sekai Project)

title.english: 1 x ½ - My Half of You

103630.description:
What do you get when you put a down-to-earth college student in a supposedly vacant apartment that’s actually full of some quirky, otherworldly creatures? A whole lot of trouble, a whole lot of cuteness, and a whole lot of fun. Sometimes cheap rent is enough to make you put up with the strangest of neighbors and roommates, but forget about sugar, spice, and everything nice; and get ready for potato chips, pranks, and everything messy!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.native: うちのアパートの妖精さん

103633.description:
The story of a family of five, living under one roof.

Winner of the New Creator Prize category of the 24th Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize (2020).
synonyms: L'eau retourne toujours à la mer

title.native: 水は海に向かって流れる
title.romaji: Mizu wa Umi ni Mukatte Nagareru

103634.description: Jang Dae-Ho, the infamous vice president of the Nine Snake Family gang overthrown after 'the purge', was disposing of dead assassins bodies in the ruins of the grand earthquake that struck the forsaken city of Kana when he found a starved and nameless orphan. Taking him under his wing and giving him the name "Gwangnam" would be the catalyst for a long and bloody revenge journey under which the name "Killberos" began. Thus, this is the dark story of Gwangnam's crime infested upbringing, riddled with the many street rivalries and gangs' power struggles that preceded the formation of the fence project and "Killberos", the guard tribe, as we know it before his passing.

103635.description:
Vice Chairman Youngjun Lee and Secretary Miso Kim have been the star duo of their company for nine years... until Miso suddenly decides to quit! But Youngjun is smart, rich, and used to getting what he wants — and he wants Miso to stay. So when he discovers she’s leaving in order to find a husband, the only logical way to keep her at his side is... offering to marry her?! Too bad she’s just not that into him!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: ¿Qué le pasa a la secretaria Kim?
Qu'est-ce qui cloche avec la secrétaire Kim ?
Was ist los mit Sekretärin Kim?

103636.description: In order to save The Paradise Island Zoo that has lost all but the female animals, the Director has made it so when night falls, all the animals turn into cute girls! It's up to Taneda to mate with all of them and save the zoo!

title.native: けもっ娘どーぶつえん

103637.description: The captivating story of an budding artist, who is willing to come out of his mother's shadow so as to paint whatever he sees... mainly things concerning the supernatural.

103639.description:
When Moe moved from Kanami to the Kawato neighborhood after marriage, she was unpopular with her new family because of a series of failures, such as burning the rice and letting the yubeshi (sweet tofu) get moldy. Although she did not know it until she realized that she was being snubbed, her mother-in-law Fujiko is notorious as "the meanest lady in Kawato."

Feeling depressed, Moe learns from the in-the-know wife Sayaka that she actually places fourth amongst the local ranking of the ten married women in the neighborhood. People sympathized with Moe for having to deal with the "meanest lady in Kawato" but she still had to bear the burden alone. Feeling like the other wives in the neighborhood might face similar problems, Moe decides to visit the other nine women on the list to see if they can help support each other.

(Source: Wikipedia, translated)
synonyms: The Other Side of Kankan Bridge

title.native: かんかん橋をわたって

103641.description:
Yuki finds himself reincarnated as a demon lord in another world, and he’s been put in charge of a dungeon to boot! Once Yuki accepts that his fate hinges on the dungeon’s survival in a world where powerful monsters roam free and danger lurks at every corner, he begins gathering allies and bolstering his defenses. Within a few days, he takes on a legendary dragon, an adorable pet slime, and a vampire girl, but despite all his precautions, life as a demon lord in a dungeon constantly under threat...is surprisingly mellow? Of course, with such a colorful cast of characters (and possibly more on their way), Yuki’s bound to wind up in some trouble. Will he be able to pull off a reckless rescue mission? And how will he and his monster girls survive an invasion by a hostile human kingdom?! Join him as he juggles daily life, responsibilities as a freshly minted demon lord, and his growing family of monster girls and pets!

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: I Became the Demon Lord so I Created a Dungeon and Spend Heartwarming Time There with Non-Human Girls

title.english: Now I'm a Demon Lord! Happily Ever After with Monster Girls in My Dungeon
title.native: 魔王になったので、ダンジョン造って人外娘とほのぼのする
title.romaji: Maou ni Natta node, Dungeon Tsukutte Jingai Musume to Honobono suru

103642.description:
One day, Joan, a young and sexually frustrated jobseeker, wakes up from a highly erotic dream only to discover that the star of that dream, a she-devil, is lying on her living room floor. So what does she do? Ask her to be her roommate, of course! With Lakam, a civil servant from Hell, she gets to enjoy all the perks of having a beautiful and perfect roommate. Large breasts, a wonderful physique, she even helps with the chores! But Lakam seems a bit too perfect. Is this arrangement truly a match made in heaven…or the beginning of hell on Earth?

(Source: Lezhin US)

103644.description:
The Nebulis Sovereignty and the Empire are embroiled in a war without end. The Ice Calamity Witch, a Nebulis mage of incredible power, and Iska, the youngest swordsman of the Empire ever to become a Saint Disciple, find themselves face-to-face on the battlefield. Each seeks to bring a close to this ceaseless conflict. Little do they know, however, that their meeting will be the catalyst that shapes the fate of the world!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: Our War that Ends the World,  or Perhaps the Crusade that Starts it Anew
Kimi to Boku no Saigo no Senjo, Aruiwa Sekai ga Hajimaru Seisen

title.english: Our Last Crusade or the Rise of a New World
title.native: キミと僕の最後の戦場、あるいは世界が始まる聖戦
title.romaji: Kimi to Boku no Saigo no Senjo, Arui wa Sekai ga Hajimaru Seisen

103645.description: Short stories about God's two cat disciples.

103646.description:
Utena has saved Anthy by defeating Akio in the final duel, but in doing so she has vanished from the world. Now the student council members at Ohtori Academy find themselves in their own revolutions.

(Source: VIZ Media)

title.english: Revolutionary Girl Utena: After the Revolution
title.native: 少女革命ウテナ After The Revolution
title.romaji: Shoujo Kakumei Utena: After The Revolution

103647.description: Short stories about two white cats who have no respect for others and are just plain cruel. Dark humour warning. Also features a standalone chapter with human characters.

103649.description: A manga about a female Judo club. Based on the story of Yuko Emoto, who brought the first gold medal to Japanese women's judo at the Atlanta Olympics in the 61kg women's category.

103650.description: Told in the form of a picture book, this is the story of a young boy who decides to commit suicide, only to find himself in a strange world after his death.
synonyms: The Dream I Had When I Died

title.native: 死んでしまったぼくの見た夢
title.romaji: Shinde Shimatta Boku no Mita Yume

103651.description: Minita Kokage, a man who was bullied in his past due to his unfortunate name, encounters something unbelievable while working his part-time job, causing his daily life to suddenly change.

103653.description:
1-2. Joshi ga Ie ni Kita! (A Woman Has Come to the House!)
Hirokazu has always been close with his older sister who is shy and very attached to him. Their relationship has been progressively getting more physical, but when the opportunity to lose his virginity to a classmate who is over at his place, what will he do?

3. Iizuka-senpai x Blazer
Toyomoto and his senior Iizuka are in love, but in order for Toyomoto to get to the same high school as Iizuka, they have decided that they'll start dating only after Toyomoto enters high school. However, when Iizuka comes to wake him up and show off her new uniform, their feelings for each other start to boil.

4. Green Eyes
Haruto's sister, Aisa, is exceptional in everything she does. As if that was not enough, her green eyes are captivating, and so whenever she looks at Haruto, he ends up following her orders. However, he doesn't mind, especially in recent times since her orders have been getting... increasingly sexual?

5. No Plan♥Play
An older sister starts becoming conscious of her 5-year-younger brother, Souta, and how he looks her legs. So, when she one time returns home tired from job hunting, she asks him to massage her feet...

6. Girls x Holes
Hajime is trying to study, but Kana, an older girl from the neighbourhood, and Marino, her classmate, are currently watching porn in his room. Expectedly, it doesn't take long for events to spiral out of control starting with Kana fingering Marino "as a joke."

7-8. Muchi Ane. (Chubby Sister)
You loves chubby girls, and his older sister currently has his ideal figure. However, this makes him worried that he will assault her, and so he decides to help her slim down working out with her but maybe not in the correct way.

9. Die in Seven Years
Minori is a high school teacher who is unable to forget the feeling of having fingers up her ass due to often having been on the recieving end of Atsuya's kancho when they were younger. Now, he has caught her masturbating in the teachers' office, and he is not going to delete the photo for nothing in exchange.

10. Suki Kirai Daisuki. Returns (Love - Hate - Really Love Returns)
Yoshiharu's is helping his beloved older sister move to her university accomodation, but before he leaves agyer finishing it, he has to make sure of how well she can hold her drink. After all, he cannot allow her to be taken advantage of at drinking parties, so he gives her an alcoholic drink when she asks for a juice, to see what happens.. That's a brother job, right?
synonyms: A Woman Has Come to the House!

title.english: Ane Kyun! My Sweet Sweet Elder Sister

103654.description:
Yukie Sakai is a sprightly young home health aide eager to help her elderly clients. But what seems like a straightforward job quickly turns into a series of increasingly surreal and bizarre adventures that put Yukie's wits to the test! Cartoonist Kago, who is well known for combining a more traditional manga style with hyper realistic illustration technique, an experimental visual storytelling approach, and outrageously sexual and scatological subject matter, has single-handedly created his own genre: "fashionable paranoia."

(Source: Fantagraphics)

Note: Includes the unrelated oneshots "Detective SumoKING" and "Separate."

103655.description:
When Akira’s class is magically summoned to another world, he and his classmates are awarded fantastical powers–but while one of them is lucky enough to become a true Hero, Akira becomes a mere Assassin. However, against all odds, the Assassin just might be the most powerful role of all! Harboring doubts about the intentions of the king, Akira uses his newfound strength as a master of the shadows to uncover the secrets and conspiracies of the crown.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: My Status as an Assassin Obviously Exceeds the Brave's
Assassin de aru ore no Sutetasu ga Yuusha yori mo Akiraka ni Tsuyoi Nodaga

title.english: My Status as an Assassin Obviously Exceeds the Hero’s
title.native: 暗殺者である俺のステータスが勇者よりも明らかに強いのだが
title.romaji: Ansatsusha de Aru Ore no Status ga Yuusha yori mo Akiraka ni Tsuyoi no da ga

103657.description:
Saku Tsukimiya is a high school boy who much to his dismay looks like a girl. On the night of his seventeenth birthday, he hears a mysterious voice in his dreams calling him a princess. When he wakes up, his body has undergone an unbelievable transformation... Saku, a man is the reincarnation of the legendary princess Kaguya?! Join us for this gender-switch love comedy!

(Source: Akita Publishing)

103658.description: December 1, 2043 AD. The mysterious life form "Baby" invades Earth and takes control of a number of human hosts, parasitising them. The possessed bodies metamorphize into monsters called "Organos," which slaughter a great mass of humanity in a series of bloody massacres, bringing mankind to the brink of extinction. Thereafter, December 1 comes to be known as "Extinction Day." While battling an Organo, Elettra, the protagonist of the story, finds that her left hand has been infected by Baby. However, aside from a throbbing pain in her hand, nothing about the rest of her body changes. Elettra begins to search for other survivors, hoping to solve the mystery of Baby.

103659.description:
Chika's girlfriend Yuina is gorgeous, fashionable, and well-to-do, but her impulse shopping sprees drive Chika absolutely batty! Yuina means well, but her way of showing affection is becoming as much of a strain on the relationship as it is on their mutual piggy-bank. Can Chika get through to her beloved and save the romance?

(Source: Irodori Comics)
synonyms: She Loves Me So Much It Bothers Me

103660.description: Four brave warriors faced the Demon King. When they were about to kill him, however, the Demon King used his remaining strength to cast a terrible curse on them and separate them. Now, the curse has taken effect. The warrior’s body has returned to that of his childhood self, the knight’s sexual orientation has changed and he’s become attracted to every man he encounters, the black mage’s gender shifted and he’s now a girl, and the white mage has disappeared. Can they reunite and break the curse? Or will they remain like that for the rest of their lives?

title.native: オレ達のパーティーは間違っている

103661.description: Vast land, unpredictable future, chaos, dragons and python will rise, who is the dragon, who is the python? or sentient beings, becoming dragons? Courts, martial arts, world beyond the immortals, generations of a thousand, barbarians, demons, monsters, ancient witchcraft, strength of a thousand, entangled by each other, and meet by fate.

title.english: Dragon Amulet: The Emperor and The Country

103662.description:
Sotoki Keisuke, A high schooler has never been lucky in his life. He has always been a "misfortune magnet". He always wishes his misfortune will end until one day when he woke up butt naked to realized a handsome guy was on top of himand said "Hand over your BUTT to me"

Later he found that the guy's name is Mahara (First prince of Latula). Mahara is not a human but a "magus". Mahara told him that both of them are fated pair and only if they are connected and his curse could be lift as it was told by the Queen....

But the Goal is not easy because they're both straight. And only Sotoki could see Mahara.

Let's see what will happen next?!
synonyms: ต้องมนต์รักเจ้าชายไม่ได้ความ

title.romaji: Fubin na Ore To Kuzu Ouji

103665.description:
1. Monkey Strip
A woman is involved with twins—one gentle and the other rough. Which one will she choose...and who says she has to?

2. Koko de Kiss shite
3. Ameagari
4. Mayonaka wa Junketsu
5. Koko ni Aru Heart

title.native: モンキー・ストリップ

103666.description:
Haruto Sakurano is a lonely boy who has been surviving on his own since his mother abandoned him. Too small and weak to defend himself from sexual assault and constantly discriminated against for being an Omega, Haruto begins prostituting himself to save money to move out of town. Then one day he meets a boy named Takagi whose calm, non-judgemental nature slowly begins filling the void in his heart.

Haruto's fear and self-loathing keep him from expressing the love he feels, but Takagi's gentle care and persistence brings them emotionally - and physically - closer together. Warmth and tenderness begin to replace Haruto's pain and loneliness, but how can Takagi convince him that he truly is worthy of being loved?

Note: Includes one extra chapter and the one-shot "Yarichin Engage (ヤリチンエンゲージ)".
synonyms: What to do With a Childish Love?

title.native: 幼稚な恋をどうしよう

103667.description:
Due to a mistake made by the goddess, my pet cat Misha who reincarnated with me was the one who became the strongest character. Furthermore, she can even speak, and is even knowledgeable of the other world.
The cheat-like Misha used transformation magic and turned into a beastkin (Nekomimi). Together with the Nekomimi young girl (sometime she is in black cat form), this is the story of our slow and leisurely life in the other world.

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

title.native: チートな飼い猫のおかげで楽々レベルアップ。さらに獣人にして、いちゃらぶします。
title.romaji: Cheat na Kaineko no Okage de Rakuraku Level Up. Sarani Juujin ni Shite, Icha Love shimasu.

103668.description:
Akitsugu has been in an unrequited love with Kei who only looks at Maya (a girl). After Akitsugu got back from a party, he found Kei in his room but this "Kei" isn't the real Kei?! What will happen to both of them?

(source: bl-gyaru)

Included one-shots: Kimi ni Ichiban Chikai Basho, Hoshikuzu no Machi, See-Through

103669.description:
You have three choices:
1. Accept that you are dead and await reincarnation in Heaven.
2. Deny that you are dead, and wander the mortal world as a ghost.
3. Curse one mortal to death, and suffer forever in Hell.

103670.description: "Stalker problem" that is overlooked as a serious social problem. The number of incidents increase day by day and are far from being solved. The curtain rises on a picaresque story set in a wonderfully distorted contemporary Japan where the warped are gathered and purified with poetic justice. What can purify darkness is darkness.

103671.description:
LUCE Resturant's floor manager Kaji Mizuki looks delicately beautiful, but is draconian when it comes to training new employees. However, Ukimi Takeru, the new server from overseas, not only is undaunted, but also addresses the manager by his first name right off the bat, hugs him, and kisses him more than what is required of a greeting. Although Mizuki was outraged, his feelings changed when he saw how serious Takeru took his job.

Included one shots: Dolce made Matenai (Can't Wait Until Dessert), Dolce yori Amai (Sweeter than Dessert)

title.native: キスはドルチェの後で
title.romaji: Kiss wa Dolce no Ato de

103672.description:
Her nickname is DKO (Danshi Koukousei Onna)—a crazy woman who loves high school boys and does whatever she can to come in contact with them, to hilarious results.

Compilation of the original Twitter series.

title.native: 男子高校生とふれあう方法

103673.description:
1. marry me!!
2. stand by me!!
3. Oka-san to Issho (おかさんといっしょ)
4. Oka-san to Issho! (おかさんといっしょ！)
5-6. Togetoge Hana to Inu (トゲトゲ花と犬)
7. Inu ga Saikin Iu koto Kikimasen (犬が最近言う事ききません)
8. Hebi no Yabou to Nemuri Neko (ヘビの野望と眠りネコ)
9. Otoko wa Damatte Jikka e Aisatsu (男はだまって実家へ挨拶)
synonyms: プリーズ マリーミー
犬が最近言う事ききません
Inu ga Saikin Iu koto Kikimasen
ヘビの野望と眠りネコ
Hebi no Yabou to Nemuri Neko

103674.description:
A man has a girlfriend but he dies, and then he possesses a school girl and rushes to meet his girlfriend.

(Source: Manga-Updates)
synonyms: My Dead Boyfriend Came Back as a High School Girl

title.native: 死んだ彼氏が女子高生になって帰ってきた
title.romaji: Shinda Kareshi ga Joushikousei ni Natte Kaettekita

103675.description:
A collection of short stories:

1. Akihiko Kaku Katariki (秋日子かく語りき); Asuka 1987-01
Middle-aged housewife Tatsuko dies after being hit by a runaway taxi, but before moving on she gets to return to life for one week by borrowing the body of Akihiko, a high school girl who survived the same accident.

2. Long Long Cake (ロングロングケーキ); Asuka 1987-06
A university student meets a shape-shifting alien.

3. Niwa wa Midori-kawa wa Blue (庭はみどり川はブルー); Bouquet 1987-08
After her death from an illness, a young woman temporarily takes over the body of her own three-year-old daughter.

4. Mizu no Naka no Tissue Paper (水の中のティッシュペーパー); Asuka 1987-10
High school girl Kuriko's precognitive dreams cause trouble when she has a dream about her boyfriend falling for someone else.
synonyms: Mizu no Naka no Tissue Paper
The Garden is Green and the River is Blue

103676.description: A pair of fraternal twins gripe to each other about having swapped bodies the month before.

title.native: 中身が入れ替わってしまった男女の双子
title.romaji: Nakami ga Irekawatteshimatta Danjo no Futago

103677.description:
Five high school classmates hold secrets close to their hearts—hidden talents, unspoken feelings, and buried pain. As they collide with each other on the path to growing up, they might jostle some of those secrets free. From Yoru Sumino, acclaimed author of I Want to Eat Your Pancreas and I Had That Same Dream Again comes a gentle, intriguing tale about love, life, and the things we leave unsaid.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

103678.description: Imamura Hinata is a high school boy with a cute appearance. Since his trauma with the first love, he wanted to be more manly than anybody else. But one day he woke up to something different...The total opposite of his ideal male body!

103679.description: An autobiographical manga about a woman and her female-to-male transgender husband.
synonyms: My Husband is too cute! I married the ex-female ikemen
Uchi no Danna ga Kawai sugiru! Moto ♀ no Ikemen to Nyuuseki Shimashita!!

title.native: うちのダンナがかわいすぎるっ！ 元♀のイケメンと入籍しました!!
title.romaji: Uchi no Danna ga Kawaisugiru! Moto ♀ no Ikemen to Nyuuseki Shimashita!!

103680.description:
Aza Kaneatsu, A samurai from Meiiji Era, who was being chased by a police. Nothing to hide...he jumped in the lake, but he cannot swim so end up drowning. And he had a Time Slip.

That which leads him to somehow in the present (140 years later). Where he meets Higaira Ikkei - the beautiful tsundere. Higaira Ikkei is next in line to take over the temple after his grandfather.

Aza's sudden arrival cause a commotion and then Ikkei's grandfather told that only true love can send Aza back to the past Era. So now, Aza is persuading Ikkei to fall in love with him...

A story with many funny moments. Let's see how the fake love change to real one?

103681.description: "Fireworks burst and die in the night sky. I exploded loving you. The fervor that burned me to death. The heat that burned me from inside. The fear known as love. The monster of summer." -pg. 1, TL by Kurt & Friends

103683.description:
Aura is a certified buff spell caster from Planet Leviathan that came to earth by a portal accident. She attends school on earth as a way of adapting, and never fails to find friends, old alien frenemies, and troubles with her buff spells.

(Source: LINE Webtoon)

103684.description:
Sometimes we just can't get out of a ditch; yet we still hope.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

title.english: All That We Hope to Be

103686.description: An odd, barrel-shaped dog displaying mischievous and human-like behavior, a cute Taru Shiba's laid-back lifestyle.

103687.description: After their journey to defeat the Demon Lord ends, a group of heroes can finally go back home.

103688.description: Saotome Amane is in her second year of high school, and again she's happily skipping school! She loves her internet, games, and anime—your run-of-the-mill shut-in. But she's different to the average NEET, being a 16-year-old schoolgirl makes her superior! ...At least that's what she thinks.
synonyms: The Everyday Life of a Truant

103728.description:
She is an assassin for hire because she needs the money. Like a chameleon, she is capable of transforming herself a numerous amount of times. To anyone that ends up meeting her, only death awaits them...

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)
synonyms: 淫欲の殺し屋ーヒノカ

103731.description: Akashi, the strongest delinquent is feared as the "red ogre." The one he falls in love with is...?

103732.description:
Permanent part-timer Yui discovers a worn-out man fallen on the street. Unable to leave the strangely charming Toshiki alone, Yui helps him back home and then accepts Toshiki while being manipulated by him. However, when Yui gets up in the morning, he finds himself locked in and unable to leave. “Confinement is my hobby,” says a smiling Toshiki. Is this confinement, or is it … Their sensitive love flickers in the space between the normal and abnormal!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

103733.description:
Proclaimed handsome elite businessman, Yuto Shinonome, falls in love at first sight with Tamaki, a beauty who’s exactly his type. It hits him like a ton of bricks when he finds out Tamaki is actually a guy!! Nevertheless, Yuto still acts like a kid with a crush and teases Tamaki like there’s no tomorrow … How can perverse Yuto handle love!?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title.native: 気ままなアイツを飼いならせ

103734.description:
Yoshiya thinks it’s fate when he’s reunited with his first love; however, he learns they can never be together … For middle-aged scriptwriter Makoto and beautiful actor-in-the-making Yuu, it’s a chance meeting in which admiration turns to love, and love turns to doubt …?! A young and heartrending adolescent love story and a bittersweet mature romance. The stories of a group of men who mingle, intertwine, and change.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

103736.description: Kosuke is killed by a truck, his soul is lost in a garden with two beautiful girls. The owner of the place will let him choose whether he will be reborn or summoned to another world, and he maintains the summons. In this new world, the main two girls who were created by the owner of the garden to help him find the mystery behind the world - a Dungeon tower. Will he be able to become the owner of this tower and manage it?

title.native: 塔の管理をしてみよう
title.romaji: Tou no Kanri wo Shite Miyou

103737.description:
Ryouta Satou gets the surprise of his life when he's suddenly transported into another world and nearly clobbered at the hands of the young, pretty adventurer Emily Brown. This new world revolves around defeating monsters and profiting on whatever they drop—food, money, items, etc. Unfortunately for Ryouta, he has no skills to speak of...until he learns he has the ability to get rare drops! Suddenly his luck turns around...or does it?

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: Level 1 with S-rank Drop Rate is the Strongest

title.english: My Unique Skill Makes Me OP even at Level 1
title.native: レベル1だけどユニークスキルで最強です
title.romaji: Level 1 dakedo Unique Skill de Saikyou desu

103738.description:
From a caste based high school, bottom-tier Masatsugu Naomi is caught up in a summon of his class to a different world. However, as soon as they arrived the king said, "This guy is unnecessary because he only has clumsy skills " and it is concluded that he is to be forced to administer the orphanage, which no one wants to do. Unfortunately for the orphanage his skills were cheat skills that cause the girls to cling to him.

In order to "defend" the girls that depend on him, he must operate the orphanage while overcoming the powerful people, authorities, and former classmates that surround him.
synonyms: Isekai de Kojiin wo Hiraita kedo
Naze ka Darehitori Sudatou to Shinai Ken
Isekai de Kojiin wo hiraitakedo nazeka darehitori sudatou to shinaiken

title.native: 異世界で孤児院を開いたけど、なぜか誰一人巣立とうとしない件
title.romaji: Isekai de Kojiin wo Hiraita kedo, Naze ka Darehitori Sudatou to Shinai Ken

103739.description:
Known as the muse of a renowned designer, Iliyan Moore has achieved almost everything a model could want: celebrity status, money, full bookings…and a reputation as a man-seducing home wrecker. No, scratch that. Iliyan has never wanted this reputation. And above else, it's completely untrue! Stalked by the paparazzi and harassed by an obsessed boss with a jealous wife, Iliyan is on guard against everyone around him. So, one could only imagine Iliyan's shock when a dashing young man by the name of Kyle Hackman manages to effortlessly charm his way past his defenses and into his bed on their first meeting… How will Iliyan manage to avoid this scandal?!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 17 extra chapters.
synonyms: プライベート・スキャンダル

103797.description: Thanks to my old man doing his best, despite it being on a two-generation housing loan, I was able to get my very own single-family house! As I went shopping on the evening of the day I moved in on my younger brother’s request, I was asked for help by a lovely blue-haired girl. Told it was a kidnapping, I took out the perpetrator with a lariat, and what appeared were actually two large eggs. As soon as I touched them, they split and two baby girls appeared! At that moment, the blue-haired girl called out, “You’re the dad!”
synonyms: On the way home I got a bride and daughter of twins

title.native: 帰宅途中で嫁と娘ができたんだけど、ドラゴンだった。
title.romaji: Kitaku Tochuu de Yome to Musume ga Dekita n dakedo, Dragon datta.

103798.description: Thanks to my old man doing his best, despite it being on a two-generation housing loan, I was able to get my very own single-family house! As I went shopping on the evening of the day I moved in on my younger brother’s request, I was asked for help by a lovely blue-haired girl. Told it was a kidnapping, I took out the perpetrator with a lariat, and what appeared were actually two large eggs. As soon as I touched them, they split and two baby girls appeared! At that moment, the blue-haired girl called out, “You’re the dad!”
synonyms: On the way home I got a bride and daughter of twins
回家路上撿到的老婆閨女, 居然是龍

title.native: 帰宅途中で嫁と娘ができたんだけど、ドラゴンだった。
title.romaji: Kitaku Tochuu de Yome to Musume ga Dekita n dakedo, Dragon datta.

103799.description: Hajime Eguchi, 10 years old, born around January to April. People call him "A young prince of a bit Eros."

103800.description: A story that follows the titular character's work as a private secretary. With Tanaka's support, a company can become invincible and achieve any future it desires.

title.english: Seiji Tanaka Secretary to the Managing President, General Time Industries
title.native: 総合時間事業会社 代表取締役社長専属秘書 田中誠司
title.romaji: Sougou Jikan Jigyou Kaisha Daihyou Torijimariyaku Kaichou Senzoku Hisho Tanaka Seiji

103801.description:
15 years ago, Kusanagi-sensei gave up her love (♀). Now, her lost love's daughter is her student?! As she wavers under the pressure of her student's relentless attacks, Kusanagi-sensei's (♀/36) era of trial begins!

Note: The web release had 360 short chapters that were compiled into 31 longer ones for the physical release.

title.native: 草薙先生は試されている

103802.description: A portrayal of the life of Che Guevara, from his childhood in Argentina to his capture and execution in La Higuera, Bolivia.

103803.description:
Unrequited love! Who is the one who makes the bottom of the heart every day? Until the taste of an adult's taste to the taste of a sister's sister.

Note: Includes 3 side stories.

103804.description:
Yeld, an orc sick of life in his dark-fantasy realm, decides to move to Tokyo and become a comics editor. One day, he’s visited by a full-time armored swordswoman, part-time aspiring manga artist—one who gets practically suicidal whenever her work gets rejected! Between her, a tentacle monster summoned as an assistant, and a slime girl with all kinds of helpful manga tools, there’s never been a stranger pack of creators! It’s the most realistic (?) depiction of the manga industry yet!

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: Ork Henshusha to Onna Kishi Mangaka

title.english: The Knight Cartoonist and her Orc Editor
title.native: オーク編集と女騎士マンガ家さん
title.romaji: Orc Henshuu to Onna Kishi Mangaka-san

103805.description:
Yuzuhara is a high school student who has lost her family and is left all alone. One day, she is reunited with her childhood friend Kouji for the first time in 10 years.

Contrary to Yuzuhara, who does not remember Kouji well, Kouji is strangely proactive, making her lunch and cleaning the house for him...

An abnormal youth love story with a slightly dangerous atmosphere.

(Source: comic-ryu, translated)

103806.description: Sango is a boy who possesses Satori's eyes, which enable him to feel lies as a “sensation of pain”. An immortal siren who gives her flesh to the man she loves. A tale of two people.

103807.description:
Rojika and Rakka live on a certain planet. They dig a hole to kill time, get a "Mystery Disc", find a "secret dungeon" in the forest, and spend every day having fun. There are a lot of things that the two still don't know on that planet ....

(Source: Kuragebunch)

title.native: 魔法少女になれません。

103810.description: The year is 2205. The "historical revisionists" have begun attacks on the past in their plot to change history. The Saniwa, who have been charged with protecting history, can imbue life into objects. Strongest among these are the Touken Danshi. The story centers around their cheerful lives.

103811.description:
The year is 1863 as the tumultuous samurai era is coming to an end, Japan is split between the pro-shogunate and anti-shogunate factions. The fate of the world is threatened as an army of historical revisionists are sent from the future to alter the course of history. In order to bring these forces down and protect the real history, two sword warriors, spirits who are swords brought to life by Saniwa (sage), rush to Edo. The polite and thoughtful Horikawa Kunihiro and the short tempered yet skillful Izuminokami Kanesada, who served the same master, confront the invading army along with a lively gang of other warriors including Mutsunokami Yoshiyuki, Yagen Toushirou, Tombokiri, and Tsurumaru Kuninaga. As the fate of history lies in these hero's hands, what meets the blade is yet to be uncovered...

(Source: Aniplex USA)

103812.description: A manga anthology based on the DMM Games/Nitroplus browser game Touken Ranbu -ONLINE-. Includes works originally published in the shoujo manga magazine Princess and on the web manga site Champion Cross.
synonyms: Touken Ranbu Anthology - Preparations for departure!

title.native: 刀剣乱舞-ONLINE-アンソロジー ―出陣準備中!―
title.romaji: Touken Ranbu Online Anthology: Shutsujin Junbichuu!

103814.description: It's the Golden Week, and Yuuta Morizono (Age 25) can't wait to spend the next 11 days staying home and conquering all of his games and manga. After a trip to the supermarket to stock up on food however, he found himself stranded in a wasteland with no sight of human - how is he going to survive with just the food he just bought?

title.native: 精霊達の楽園と理想の異世界生活
title.romaji: Seirei-tachi no Rakuen to Risou no Isekai Seikatsu

103815.description: From a caste based high school, bottom-tier Masatsugu Naomi is caught up in a summon of his class to a different world. However, as soon as they arrived the king said, "This guy is unnecessary because he only has clumsy skills " and it is concluded that he is to be forced to administer the orphanage, which no one wants to do. Unfortunately for the orphanage his skills were cheat skills that cause the girls to cling to him. In order to "defend" the girls that depend on him, he must operate the orphanage while overcoming the powerful people, authorities, and former classmates that surround him.

title.native: 異世界で孤児院を開いたけど、なぜか誰一人巣立とうとしない件
title.romaji: Isekai de Kojiin wo Hiraita kedo, Naze ka Darehitori Sudatou to Shinai Ken

103816.description:
Masuda Keima just wants to sleep. Too bad for him, he’s been pulled from sweet dreams and comfy sheets into a fantasy dungeon in another world! Not only is he charged with protecting it, but failure to do so will cost him his life. His only guide is the personification of the Dungeon Core, Rokuko–but she’s a moron who can’t even figure out how to drive away a group of bandits. If Keima ever wants to get some quality shut-eye again, he’ll have to take over running this dungeon himself!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Dungeon master wants to sleep now and forever...
I absolutely don't want to work as a dungeon master until I indulge in my laziness
ช่วยขยันหน่อยได้ไหม นายดันเจี้ยนมาสเตอร์

title.native: 絶対に働きたくないダンジョンマスターが惰眠をむさぼるまで
title.romaji: Zettai ni Hatarakitakunai Dungeon Master ga Damin wo Musaboru made

103818.description: Miyako and her romantic journey through time enthused the fans. With this volume, the series will be given a fitting conclusion. In four short stories, author Kyoko Kumagai deals again with all our favorite characters and invites you to dream.
synonyms: The Wandering Single Wing: Satellite Stories
Miyako: Auf den Schwingen der Zeit - Satellite Stories

title.native: 片翼のラビリンス サテライトストーリーズ

103820.description:
"Honey, be a good girl and stay quiet. How are you going to repay me for saving you?" Newly-wed Xia Nuanxin is an out-and-out thief, and meeting Xiao Jueze is the biggest mistake she's ever made. As a result, she has to forcibly submit herself to him.With just a flash of his evil eyes, he carries her away on his shoulder...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

103821.description: On the first day of high school Nohara Tama - who is just a plain, ordinary girl - gets herself involved in a heated argument between two baseball fans. As a result, Saitama White Cats fan Nishitake Reona and Fukuoka Falcons fan Daiei Haruko drag her to the baseball stadium. How will the fate of Tama - who doesn't know the first thing about baseball - play out!?
synonyms: Take Me to the Baseball Stadium

title.native: 私を球場に連れてって！

103822.description:
Won-Young gets unjustly suspended from work after getting caught up in a corruption scandal. But when he accidentally discovers the chairman's favorite artist Yoon Tae-Jun living under an alias, he is tasked with a tricky new mission. Could this be Won-Young's chance to get his job back?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: ปั้นรักฉันด้วยใจนาย
非意図的恋愛談～俺は恋愛なんか求めてない！～

103823.description:
A brokenhearted Masato moves into his friend’s second home looking for some peace and quiet, but instead he finds a man who’s very much not his type already occupying the space. Can this messy, ill-tempered intruder help mend his broken heart?

Masato just wants some peace and quiet on his day off, but the kids upstairs continue to make that impossible, so he escapes to his friend Naruse’s gay bar. Sympathetic to his ongoing plight, Naruse recommends Masato just move into his second home since he’s not using it. But upon his arrival, Masato find a gruff, untidy older man already living there. Does this real-life odd couple stand a chance as roomies…and perhaps something more?

(Source: SuBLime)

103824.description:
1. Joker no Amai Uso
2. Zoku Joker no Amai Uso
3. Joker to Amai Mitsu
4. Joker to Amai Natsu
5. Joker to Awai Yuuutsu
6. Joker to Amai Koi
7. Joker no Amai Uso Sonogo

103825.description:
Xin Yun is a loser in all the lives he was reborn into, always carefree instead of working hard.

Recently reborn, he finds himself in the past and with the chance to change the course of the future.

Follow Xin Yun's epic journey of self-cultivation to become the true hero of his story.

(Source: INKR)

103826.description:
Lee Hyuk’s a medical student at a good university, but his goals are more artistic. So he decides to chase his dreams by stealing his sister’s money and running away from home! He lands himself a teaching job and a place to stay, and everything is going great until he discovers his landlord is his student and school delinquent, Lee Biru. Hyuk may be the adult, but he has no real life experience. Biru, on the other hand, is independent, and more than capable of fending for himself. A coming-of-age story about two men who hate each other, but are exactly what each other needs.

(Source: Lezhin US)

103827.description:
Natsugami remains remembering the beautiful boy he once met in an abandoned building named Aki. It was due to trauma after seeing him being violated by someone in that same place.

His junior, Miyoshi, confessed to him but he couldn’t embark on another journey of feelings because of these memories. In order to face Miyoshi’s feelings and his past to unravel more details of Aki, he went back to that abandoned place, with Miyoshi tailing him.
synonyms: We are Looking for that Summer Love in the Secret.

title.romaji: Natsu ni Tokeru Himitsu no Koi

103828.description:
1. Toriaezu Kiss shite Kudasai (とりあえずキスしてください)
Nenji, touch me again! High-schooler, Taira has got a one-sided crush on his buddy, Nenji. One day, Taira invites Nenji over to his place to watch some of his older brother's porn collection, but in the heat of it all, they get turned on and things progress.

2. Kiss wo Shite, Sorekara (キスをして、それから)
3. Otsukai kara Kaettara (おつかいから帰ったら)
4-6. Shoujo Manga Mitai na Koi wo, (少女漫画みたいな恋を、)

title.native: とりあえずキスしてください

103829.description:
The "miracle love story" follows a girl named Runa who dreams of being happily married, like her lovey-dovey parents whom she adores. However, she has a secret she cannot tell anyone. Moreover, she has to deal with a somewhat odd love triangle.

Note: The oneshot 14-sai no Tenshi is included.

103830.description:
Youichi Sawa is a college student vexed by his crush on Nanao, his tutoring student and promising ballet dancer. Sweet but arrogant, Nanao has a girlfriend, and Yoichi decides to keep his feelings a secret. But, when Nanao asks Youichi to have sex wit him, he is powerless to refuse. What started out as only a physical relationship slowly grows into a ten year story of love, heartbreak, and reunion.

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

103831.description: Momota Taichi (17) first wore a skirt one summer day. As a model student, with an older girlfriend, his sudden action disrupts the peace of his classmates and teachers. The only one who finds it fun is his classmate Shirai-san, known for being a bit odd.

103833.description: The story features Colonial Operator ROCO143, Jolie, finding a paper airplane floating through space. It's a nice story because the paper airplane in the comic represents humanity's dreams and visions of the universe.

synonyms: Braids: Case of the Braid Killer

103835.description: A mysterious mastermind single-handedly releases 206 of the most dangerous prisoners around the states. When the prisoners rampage New York City, the police helplessly watch as a young boy with a katana appears. His mechanical arm has a countdown from 206; what is his purpose?

103836.description: Middle-schooler Naoko was saved by two boys after nearly drowning in the sea. She discovers they're both third years at her new school and is torn between the two.

103837.description:
Ryou is crushing on his pretty boy senpai, Kanta, and on a whim, he locks Kanta up at his place.
When he comes to his senses, Ryou begs for forgiveness by prostrating on the ground. But, for some reason, Kanta stays on and bums around every day. What's worse, Kanta starts treating Ryou like his gofer...?!
The love of a lovable doofus and a sarcastic pretty boy when the situation gets reversed!

(Source: Fujoshi Bitches)
synonyms: I Became A Captive To Your Charm!

103838.description: The story of how the infamous female Gumiho came to be.

103839.description:
In this surrealist collection of stories, it follows the lives of several girls and their interactions with dicks that have been chopped off. Once off a guy's body, the dicks act as separate living creatures with a mind of their own.

Note: Includes an extra.

title.native: それはただの先輩のチンコ
title.romaji: Sore wa Tada no Senpai no Chinko

103840.description: When Theodore was dropped into a waterway by his half-brother, he suddenly recalled the memory of his past life. He had been a Japanese citizen known as Kirishima Kagehisa, placed inside VRMMO character he had made in Break Force Online. "Theodore" is a Combat Mage that Kagehisa played within BFO, and he realized his skills were progressing well even in this other world. Theodore, who had lightly brushed off his half-brother to make his own place in the world, had ventured off to the large labyrinth existing at the Boundary City, Termuilles.
synonyms: Boundary Labyrinth and Magician of Alien World

title.native: 境界迷宮と異界の魔術師
title.romaji: Kyoukai Meikyuu to Ikai no Majutsushi

103842.description: Kagefumi Merry takes place before the events of Yumekui Merry, and follows the adventures of a slightly different Merry than we are familiar with.

103843.description:
The manga follows masked wrestler Genzou Shibata, who likes all kinds of animals and creatures. One day he is summoned to another world, where a princess asks him to help kill magical beasts, but he gets mad and puts her in a German suplex. Instead, he begins life as a pet shop owner in the other world.

(Source: Anime News Network)

Note: The chapter count reflects the original serialization before chapters were merged in the volume releases. The 12 extra chapters are also counted.
synonyms: เคโมโนมิจิ ร้านสัตว์เลี้ยงในโลกแฟนตาซี

103844.description: A guy who is interested in designing lingerie applies to work at a lingerie company, and as the sole male employee, he finds himself surrounded by women who want to have sex with him.

title.native: らんじぇりー・ぱにっく

103845.description:
Opposites attract in this new high school yuri manga!

Fujishiro Nanaki is super cute, super popular, and super annoyed with anyone as plain as her classmate Kurokawa Kanade. When Nanaki finds out her boyfriend’s cheating on her, however, her life makes a complete 180—as does her relationship with Kanade. This all-new yuri manga series explores the budding romance between the cool girl in school and the “plain” girl she once brushed off!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
103845.hashtag: #でき姫 #できそこないの姫君たち
synonyms: รักไม่ได้ดั่งใจของเจ้าหญิง

title.native: できそこないの姫君たち

103846.description:
1) Kouyasai de Ikou! (後夜祭でイこう！); Comic Koh 2017-07
2) Konna Mura Iya da! (こんな村いやだっ！); Comic Tenma 2016-04
3) Youkoso Paisen: AV Joyuu no Kagai Jugyou (ようこそパイセン～AV女優の課外授業～); Comic Tenma 2015-07
4) Gaman Dekinai! (ガマンできないッ！); Comic Tenma 2014-11
5) Happy Birthday to You! (ハッピーバースデートゥーユー！); Comic Tenma 2015-11
6) Kyou-Iku!? Jisshusei (今日イク!?実習生); Comic Tenma 2014-09
7) Bosshuu shimasu! (没収します！); Comic Tenma 2015-04
8) Batsu wo Kakugo no Shinken Renai! (バツを覚悟の真剣恋愛！); Comic Tenma 2014-07
9) Motto Miteite (もっと見ていて); Comic Koh 2017-01
synonyms: Youkoso Paisen: AV Joyuu no Kagai Jugyou

103848.description:
Spin-off manga of THE IDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls, focusing on Takumi Mukai.

Note: Chapter count includes 5 extra chapters.

title.english: The iDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls WILD WIND GIRL
title.native: アイドルマスター シンデレラガールズ WILD WIND GIRL
title.romaji: The iDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls WILD WIND GIRL

103849.description:
Spin-off manga of THE IDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls, focusing on younger idols. The manga centers around girls under 149 centimeters tall (under about 4-feet, 11-inches) who aspire to be idols despite not having a producer or gigs. However, maybe with a marvelous dress, a marvelous stage, and a marvelous prince ... The new Cinderella story follows these small idols and their small rookie producer.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

Note: The chapter count includes 152 chapters released in magazine and 33 extra chapters.

title.native: アイドルマスター シンデレラガールズ U149

103850.description:
Noir is the son of a minor noble with very little to his name other than a job offer–which is canceled before he can even start his first day. He does possess one rare trait, though: the magical ability to consult with a great sage, even if using the skill gives him terrible headaches! Unsure of what his future holds, he accesses the sage for advice on how to move forward and is directed to a secret dungeon filled with rare beasts and magical items. It is here that Noir will train, compiling experience and wealth, until he’s powerful enough to change his fate.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes 6 extra chapters.
synonyms: Special training in the Secret Dungeon!

title.english: The Hidden Dungeon Only I Can Enter
title.native: 俺だけ入れる隠しダンジョン　～こっそり鍛えて世界最強～
title.romaji: Ore dake Haireru Kakushi Dungeon: Kossori Kitaete Sekai Saikyou

103851.description:
Noir is the son of a minor noble with very little to his name other than a job offer–which is canceled before he can even start his first day. He does possess one rare trait, though: the magical ability to consult with a great sage, even if using the skill gives him terrible headaches! Unsure of what his future holds, he accesses the sage for advice on how to move forward and is directed to a secret dungeon filled with rare beasts and magical items. It is here that Noir will train, compiling experience and wealth, until he’s powerful enough to change his fate.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Special training in the Secret Dungeon!

title.english: The Hidden Dungeon Only I Can Enter
title.native: 俺だけ入れる隠しダンジョン　～こっそり鍛えて世界最強～
title.romaji: Ore dake Haireru Kakushi Dungeon: Kossori Kitaete Sekai Saikyou

103852.description:
The story centers on Kaede Honjou, who is invited by her friend Risa Shiramine to play a virtual reality MMO game with her. While Kaede doesn't dislike games, what she really, truly dislikes is being in pain. She creates a character named Maple, and decides to put all her points in VIT to minimize pain. As a result, she moves slowly, can't use magic, and even a rabbit can get the best of her. However, as it turns out, she acquires a skill known as "Absolute Defense" as a result of her pumping points into VIT, as well as a "Counter Skill" that works against special moves. Now, with her ability to nullify all damage, she goes on adventures.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)
synonyms: I hate being in pain,  so I think I'll make a full defense build
Itai no wa Iya nanode Bougyo-Ryoku ni Kyokufuri Shitai to Omoimasu.
น้องโล่สายแทงก์ แกร่งเกินร้อย
怕痛的我，把防禦力點滿就對了

title.english: Bofuri: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense.
title.native: 痛いのは嫌なので防御力に極振りしたいと思います。
title.romaji: Itai no wa Iya nano de Bougyoryoku ni Kyokufuri Shitai to Omoimasu.

103853.description:
Kaede Honjou has never been much of a gamer. So when her best friend, Risa, ropes her into trying out the hit new VRMMO NewWorld Online, her biggest concern is…whether it will hurt! Her solution? To dump all her stat points into defense! She may not have anything in the way of magic, agility, or strength, but her extreme build transforms her from a total noob into a nigh-invulnerable walking fortress the game’s admins never accounted for!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: I hate being in pain  so I think I'll make a full defense build

Bofuri - Je ne suis pas venue ici pour souffrir
怕痛的我，把防禦力點滿就對了
아픈 건 싫으니까 방어력에 올인하려고 합니다.

title.english: Bofuri: I Don't Want to Get Hurt, so I'll Max Out My Defense.
