title.romaji: Itai no wa Iya nano de Bougyoryoku ni Kyokufuri Shitai to Omoimasu.

103854.description:
It’s a rude insult when lowly and headstrong servant Edna comes to marry Duke Eli, instead of the noble daughter he expected. But the ambitious maid hides an even bigger secret behind her obvious ruse – one that could change the kingdom’s very history. Can the two find freedom, redemption – and love – without drawing their swords on each other? Based on the hit novels.

(Source: Tappytoon)

103855.description:
Do you want a refund on your life? Start earning karma at The Refund High School to reincarnate as an ideal version of yourself.

(Source: WEBTOONS)
synonyms: ชีวิตนักเรียนฉัน ขอคืนเถอะนะ

103856.description:
Intrepid traveler Shin has been to practically every country on the world map, except for the blank space around 500 kilometers away from his homeland. However, the moment he takes a single step forward, he's immediately captured and told that anyone who comes to Oraie can never leave. As Shin carves out a place for himself in Oraie, he gets to know more about its young leader Musutia, who bears the responsibility for Oraie's fate and future on his frail shoulders. He also meets Musutia's beautiful retainer Noe, whose duties often entail giving Musutia a "healing kiss." But is this just a ritual between master and servant? Or is there potential for it to blossom into anything more?

(Source: futekiya)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: Sonoyo no Dokoka Chizu ni nai Kuni
Irgendwo auf dieser Welt – Jenseits aller Karten

title.english: An Unmapped Country, Somewhere In This World
title.native: その世のどこか、地図にない国
title.romaji: Sono Yo no Dokoka, Chizu ni Nai Kuni

103857.description:
Yusuke has made up his mind to quit his long shut-in life and start college. A handsome guy named Haruki appears before him as his home tutor. Haruki's lessons are easy to understand, but there is a lot of touching and Yusuke is constantly toyed with every day. One day, Haruki says, "It's normal to do something like this between friends," and helps Yusuke masturbate...! This is an innocent story about a handsome, two-faced home tutor and an awkward shut-in who start off as friends.

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: The Masked Tutor and Innocent Shut-In
title.native: 仮面カテキョとピュアニート

103858.description:
1-3. Josou Danshi Mii-chan to Sono Kareshi? Kei-kun (女装男子みいちゃんとその彼氏？けい君, Mimi the Cross-Dresser and His Boyfriend Kei)
Life is peaceful for Keiichi at his all-boys school. But one day, his classmate and best friend, Minami Sonoda, asks him out. Confused by these sudden gay advances, Keiichi rejects him and makes a run for it... But, that's not where it ends. The next day, Minami appears in front of Keiichi again, dressed completely as a girl, and brazenly vows never to give up on Keiichi's heart...!! Will things at school ever be the same again...?

(Source: Renta!)

4. Nagasare Toudou-kun to Kojirase Kitamine-kun (流され東堂くんとこじらせ北嶋くん)
5-6. Bokura Platonic... de Irareru Wake Nai Daro! (僕らプラトニック…でいられるわけないだろ!)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: 流され東堂くんとこじらせ北嶋くん
僕らプラトニック…でいられるわけないだろ!
Bokura Platonic... de Irareru Wake Nai Daro!

title.english: Mimi the Cross-Dresser and His Boyfriend Kei
title.native: 女装男子みいちゃんとその彼氏？けい君
title.romaji: Josou Danshi Mii-chan to Sono Kareshi? Kei-kun

103859.description: God messed up. I reincarnated. Born in a countryside village, I’m surrounded by beautiful imoutos and a childhood friend who’s a girl. No electricity and no water, this’ll be the ultimate slow life! Helping with farm work and animals, and yet my house turned into a huge shop where female adventurers happen to come around! Today is also very busy for me. This is the story of my slow life.

title.native: 村人転生 最強のスローライフ
title.romaji: Murabito Tensei: Saikyou no Slow Life

103860.description:
Can memories ever be repaired?
Tired of her work and love, Akari has moved to the town where she spent a little time of her life there. At the corner of the desolate shopping district, she meets the owner of a watch store that has a strange plate on the display window. Thus, Akari starts her new life.
synonyms: Repairing the Time of Your Memories

title.native: 思い出のとき修理します

103861.description:
"Who cares about being cute?! Rosemarie is a young girl who got reincarnated in the world of a dating sim. That game was famous for being a crappy game full of hopeless men! She has a bad feeling about it, but she has no time to waste getting upset about it! She's going to change the peculiar dateable character for the better and meet the man she really loves at all costs!"

(Source: POCKET COMICS)
synonyms: Tensei Oujo wa Kyou mo Hata o Tatakioru
The Reincarnated Princess Strikes Down Flags Today as Well

title.english: Rosemarie Reincarnated: Fixing bad suitors and getting her beloved.
title.native: 転生王女は今日も旗を叩き折る
title.romaji: Tensei Oujo wa Kyou mo Hata wo Tatakioru

103862.description:
After an accident, a modern careerist is reborn as Princess Rosemary Von Velfalt. She soon realizes that her new life is identical to that of a rival character in an otome game that she’d once played to “100%” completion. Luxury and magic abound in the Kingdom of Nevel, alongside a collection of attractive men. However, beneath the suitors' dazzling faces lie awful personalities: masochists, necrophiles, and perverts, oh my! But it’s not all bad news—the side characters are perfect, and Rosemary has fallen for the captain of the royal guard. Since the game offers no true route to happiness, Rosemary decides to forge her own path; to avoid marriage with the suitors, she'll have to skip their story routes and fix their deviance. She’ll navigate palace and marriage politics, kidnappings, and the threat of war, all while contending with a world that’s drifting further from the game she remembers. “100%” game completion isn’t all it’s cracked up to be—sometimes, “0%” is the route to a dream life!

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: Tensei Oujo wa Kyou mo Hata o Tatakioru
The Reincarnated Princess Strikes Down Flags Today as Well

title.english: The Reincarnated Princess Spends Another Day Skipping Story Routes
title.native: 転生王女は今日も旗を叩き折る
title.romaji: Tensei Oujo wa Kyou mo Hata wo Tatakioru

103864.description:
Junhee's a pushover and has somehow managed to lend out all his money. He finally finds a great part-time gig, but it's only for women! In serious need of the cash, he dresses up as a girl only to discover the job he's just applied for is a clinical trial on a libido pill for women. Not only is he locked in for a week with five other (ahem, horny) women, they're all women from his high school! How long before everyone discovers he's not a she?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Under Observation: My First Loves and I

103865.description: Living the high school life, being admired by all the other species in his school, Rurikawa (Wolf. Alpha. Male.) meets a lower species, Kyougokuin (Rabbit. Beta. Male.) As soon as their eyes meet, Rurikawa thinks, "I want to breed this beautiful creature." He's suddenly unable to control his urges as he's turned on. In a world where men can also become pregnant, this series tells the story of high school boys being led around by their instincts and fate.

103866.description:
Though 4th year elementary school student Aikawa Himeno has feelings for her classmate Ouji-kun, why can't she properly express her feelings? A story of a slightly precocious love comedy.

Note: Includes 22 extra chapters.
synonyms: For Himeno-chan, Love Is (Still) Too Early
Love is Still Too Early for Himeno-chan

title.native: 姫乃ちゃんに恋はまだ早い
title.romaji: Himeno-chan ni Koi wa Mada Hayai

103867.description: In a world completely ruled by Crane Games... we follow the adventures of a girl who has the power to turn it all upside down.

title.native: ゆるっとハンター☆ワンタンちゃん

103868.description:
Straight A student Yuka is a little too honest for her own good and has no friends but unexpectedly begins dating Haruomi after he helps her out of a difficult situation. The only problem is, Haruomi has a strict policy of dating someone new every Monday…

(Source: Tokyo Otaku Mode)

Included one-shot:
Volume 2: Hatsu Date (A First Date)
synonyms: Good way to find true love.

103869.description: A collection of horror stories by Sachiko Uguisu/Hiyodori. The first 3 chapters are about the Freudstein twins, while the others are stand-alones.

title.native: フロイトシュテインの双子

103875.description:
With all its innovations, the kingdom of Tempest—founded by the demon lord Rimuru—is a veritable paradise for travelers such as Framea, the rabbitfolk chief’s daughter. Framea has always had a nose for adventure, an inquisitive mind, and a knack for discovering and identifying the latest and greatest the world has to offer! Her notepad is open at all times, ready for any three-star delights she may encounter, so when Rimuru himself gives Framea a mission to catalog the area’s attractions, she’ll have her work cut out for her—and tons of stars to hand out!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken - The Ways of Strolling in the Demon Country
Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken: Mabutsu no Kuni no Arukikata
เกิดใหม่ทั้งทีก็เป็นสไลม์ไปซะแล้ว ~เที่ยวทั่วแคว้นแดนอสูร~
Der Schleim-Reiseführer in das Land der Dämonen
Moi quand je me réincarne en slime - Comment vivre chez les monstres ?
전생했더니 슬라임이었던 건에 대하여 ~마물의 나라를 즐기는 법~

title.english: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime: The Ways of the Monster Nation
title.native: 転生したらスライムだった件～魔物の国の歩き方～
title.romaji: Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken: Mamono no Kuni no Arukikata

103876.description: Soujirou possesses a special predisposition that causes him to "transform into another gender when his heart throbs." Moreover, her girlfriend, Ichijou Sakura, is an elite young lady who came to acquire the same special predisposition as well. Their love life is filled with chaotically transforming between male and female; is this normal romance or girl's love or boy's love or other!? This is a love comedy featuring transformation between male and female★

title.native: にぶんのいちボーイフレンド

103877.description:
Megumi finally lands her dream job at a toy company! Assigned to the Girls’ Toy Division, which produces her beloved “Carefree Cat” brand, she’s bursting with excitement as her new career begins. But on her very first day, a man she meets in the elevator gives her the wrong directions, causing her to step out on the wrong floor! What Megumi doesn’t realize is that the man who misled her is actually her new boss—someone notorious within the company for being incredibly strict and intimidating…?!

An office romance filled with misunderstandings, surprises, and growing feelings begins!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

Notes:
- Includes the one-shot "Watashi no Hanashi (わたしの話)".
- Includes the one-shot "Kanojo ni Rusuban wa Makaserarenai (彼女に留守番は任せられない)".

103878.description: The popular Idol group "X Girl" is going to perform at a live venue, fans are eagerly awaiting their appearance. But this time, the three beautiful sexy idols are high up in the sky on a secret mission, with their airplane's cockpit damaged it descends upon the concert venue.

103879.description:
After a very rocky start, Asaichi and Yoru begin their passion-filled dating life! Although the band's popularity has remained steady, Asaichi was no longer content with being a small-time band. He wants fame! He wants success! And so, he begins to dream of the band's future. Trouble arises when Yoru reveals that he has some fans stalking him. Asaichi offers Yoru a spare key to his place and they begin officially living together.

How will their relationship fare? Where will their band go? As they worry, struggle and fall in love, what does the future hold as their group's plans begin to grow?

(Source: Kuma)
synonyms: Yoru to Asa no Uta Encore
The Song of Yoru & Asa Ec
W rytmie wieczoru i poranka: Bis!
La canción de Yoru y Asa Bis
The Song of Night and Day - La Canzone di Yoru e Asa

title.english: The Song of Yoru & Asa Encore
title.romaji: Yoru to Asa no Uta EC

103880.description: Fujishiro Naito, high school year one, is really bad with girls. Dodging girl after girl, he's finally managed to enter the boys-only school of his dreams… Or so he thought! Little did he know that the school is becoming a coeducational school from this year!! Having realized this fact only on opening day, Naito stood at a loss right in front of the school gate. It was then that he met the girl nicknamed "the Pure White Princess" – Ichinose Himeka…

title.native: ひめドレ 姫と奴隷の学園生活
title.romaji: Himedore: Hime to Dorei no Gakuen Seikatsu

103881.description: The unexpected reunion of a proper girl and a delinquent girl. A love story is developed between the two.

103882.description: Isei’s life crumbled right before his eyes as the one he fell in love with died. But when everything seems dark in his life something happens...

103883.description:
The manga centers on Mami, a normal high school girl, and his not-so-normal relationship with Asano. Asano, the actor (though not popular). Asano, the genius (though he gets too serious in his roles and loses his job). Asano, the hottie (though nobody knows about him). Asano works at the neighborhood convenience store near Mami's place, which provides her an opportunity to be with her beloved. But in the throes of her passion, she is suddenly roped into becoming the store's manager.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)
synonyms: Please Take Care of Our Asano

title.native: うちの浅野がすみません

103884.description:
High schoolers (and stepsisters) Yuzu and Mei have gone public with their relationship! The two are happy to be dating out in the open, but friends and family keep trying to butt in with advice. Can Yuzu and Mei figure things out on their own?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

103885.description:
In a town filled with the most beautiful of beings, Tinker is the ugly freak who lives on the fringes of society. One day, one of these beings visits his workshop in order to have a trinket fixed, and it is this seemingly innocuous occurrence that sets into motion a series of unfortunate events…

Winner of the Four Seasons Award in 2017 Winter.

103890.description:
Ninjas enjoyed glory in the Japan of bygone times. They disappeared when their organizations were dissolved during the country's Allied occupation of Japan. However, their existence continued in secret. Some say that their ranks numbered 200,000 members. Among these, elite ninjas covertly dealt with crises at a national level. On the other hand, marginal members found work hard to come by. One of these ninjas between jobs was Kuro Kumogakure.

(Source: K Manga)

103891.description: For as long as she can remember, Maho has lived as the adopted daughter of a miko at a shrine with a mermaid goddess. Although she's curious, she's fine with the many restrictions that her adoptive mother enforces. Then she meets a mysterious woman, Rena, by the shore who never ages and asks Maho to keep her existence a secret.
synonyms: 私のカラダが濡れている…～えっちな人魚姫～

103892.description: Young Ena finds a new job as a maid at the residence of Madam Milena, who recently lost her husband. And when the night comes...

103893.description: Keiko is a divorced single mother in her mid-forties, who lives a good, normal life with a stable job. That is, until she catches her only daughter, Mayu, having sex with her girlfriend, Saori. She pretends she hadn't seen them, but she can't help but see Saori in a different light. While she ponders how to deal with the situation as Mayu's mother, Saori is about to make that decision for her.

103894.description:
Takara Taiyou is a studious high school student who joins the Cultural Research Society due to the fact that there are no active club members and he'd be able to concentrate on his studying. However, his arch enemy, the beautiful and academically gifted Bandai Kaname, also joins for the same reason. Together, they become interested in the old toys in this club room… Girl X Boy X nostalgic toys comedy !!

(Source: Flex Comix, translated)

Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.

title.native: 万代かなめは遊びたい

103895.description: NEW GAME! anthology by various mangaka.

title.native: NEW GAME! アンソロジーコミック

103897.description: Shuu is a member of the literary club that can’t write. One day, he gets a mysterious message on his phone from a girl called Eina, and from that impulsive contact, they begin to exchange messages. They talk of things like their shared interest in novels and grow close. However, when they try and meet, they discover a shocking truth. Eina lives… not in the present, but five years in the past! How will their love develop, parted by five years of nights…!?
synonyms: I Hold Your Voice Alone, Under The Starry Sky

title.native: 星空の下、君の声だけを抱きしめる
title.romaji: Hoshizora no Shita, Kimi no Koe dake wo Dakishimeru

103898.description: Japan one day suddenly materialises in another world. The Japanese government is put into chaos amid food shortages and many other issues. The JSDF is dispatched to survey the area and find out as much information as possible, the JSDF discover dragons during their search and men riding dragons. From this the Government confirms their beliefs the entire nation had been transported to another world. Negotiations between the government and their new neighbours swiftly begin in hopes of solving the food problem as quickly as possible. How were they transported here, why were they transported and what awaits the nation in this other world?

103899.description: Hane is finally starting high school after being in and out of hospitals throughout most of her childhood. On her first day, she musters up the courage to greet one of her classmates, Kotori, only to witness him fist-fight upperclassmen. Seeing the fight, Hane faints and is readmitted to the hospital, and while she's recovering, Kotori surprisingly comes to visit her. Could this delinquent be more than meets the eye? "A sparkling new love story"!

title.native: Jewelry－はねと小鳥の素晴らしき日々－
title.romaji: Jewelry: Hane to Kotori no Subarashiki Hibi

103901.description: The setting is 15th century France. A girl named Cerisier, coming from a poor, rural family, sets out to the capital to seek work. On her way there she unexpectedly acquires an oversized sword, the Zweihander. Guided by the girls she met at the capital, she decides to set her sights on becoming a female knight. Everything carries a fresh sense of excitement to her, whether it’s her first glance at weapons and armor, her life in the capital, or the instruction she receives at the Girls Knight Academy. This is the bright, shining life she spends with those sharing the same dream as her!

103902.description:
Ian joins the psychic organization N.E.R.D by chance. Will he be able to survive amongst the dangerous women of N.E.R.D?

(Source: Toomics)

103903.description: This story is about a Kouhai who tries to cover for a Senpai who is full of openings.
synonyms: The Daily life of A Certain Office Lady Who Can’t Take Her Eyes Off Her Senpai

title.native: 先輩から目が離せないとある会社員の日常
title.romaji: Senpai Kara Me ga Hanasenai To Aru Kaishain no Nichijou

103904.description: Newly-instated detective Ishida Tomohiro returns home one day to find a naked man in his house. He asks Tomohiro to identify himself, only to vanish into thin air before the startled young man can come up with a response. Soon afterwards, Tomohiro becomes tangled up in an odd situation involving a killer sword that can possess people. Then the same guy shows up again: this time fully clothed and actually physically present. "Kyousuke" is a member of the supernatural task force affiliated with the police, and Tomohiro ends up being transferred there. Now he'll have to handle all sorts of bizarre and out-of-this-world situations alongside his extremely quirky new colleagues!

title.native: 全裸男と柴犬男 警視庁生活安全部遊撃捜査班
title.romaji: Zenra Otoko to Shibainu Otoko: Keishichou Seikatsu Anzenbu Yuugeki Sousahan

103905.description: Three beautiful sisters only sing and dance all day in Spring and Fall, but what will happen in the Winter?

103906.description: After he discovers he is gay, university student Oda wants to have sex with someone, so he meets up with someone he finds on a dating website. That man is a gentleman, so Oda calls him "Casanova." They were supposed to have a one-night stand and not know each other's identities, but whatever he does, Oda cannot forget him...

title.native: モテパパと抱かれたい純情講師
title.romaji: Mote Papa to Dakaretai Junjou Koushi

103907.description:
Raised in all-girls schools through elementary and middle school, Kano has an especially strong fascination with boys. Finally enrolled in a co-ed high school, Kano fantasizes about interacting with boys, but Tamao, the boy sitting next to her, is... a little strange!? A wholesome first-love romantic comedy between a desire-driven girl and a mysterious genius boy begins!

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

Note: Originally completed with four volumes and 16 chapters on 2019-11-10, the serialization restarted on Manga Mee on 2024-01-02.

103908.description:
High school student Yang Ming is a typical underachiever. He gets into fights, skips class, and cheats on his schoolwork. When the school flower confronts him, he feels ashamed and wants to change, but he has fallen too far behind. However, by a stroke of fate, he ends up gaining a pair of contacts that allow him to change his visual perspective, completely altering the course of his future!

(Source: Webnovel)

103910.description: One day, Ruka-- the plain, common, unelegant "Useless Princess"-- meets Juri, a young man from the Royalty Inspection Bureau. A royal's popularity is an important measure proportional to their power over the country. To escape the influence of her popularity, she begins her intensive training with Juri in order to survive the vicious competition of the Royal Idol Era!

103917.description: The often-ill and unskilled-in-love Akane Is teaching a demon-like boy about love!?
synonyms: Itsutsu no Hajimete: Ubawarete mo Ii

title.native: 5つのハジメテ-うばわれてもいい、キミになら-
title.romaji: 5-tsu no Hajimete: Ubawarete mo Ii, Kimi ni Nara

103918.description:
A ferocious wolf trades her singing voice for a human form so that she can guide a blind prince to the witch's house, deep in the forest. Hopefully there, she can restore his sight.

Promotional shorts for a video game of the same title.
synonyms: Liar Princess and the Blind Prince

103995.description:
After binge-watching beauty videos online, a shy comic book fan masters the art of makeup and sees her social standing skyrocket as she becomes her school’s prettiest pretty girl overnight. But will her elite status be short-lived? How long can she keep her real self a secret? And what about that cute boy who knows her secret?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 33 side stories.
synonyms: ความลับของนางฟ้า

103998.description:
A collection of a dozen hot and humorous tales, brimming with hot thots and cute full-figured women. Each of Momi’s shorts is bursting with a sense of humor that'll leave any reader in stitches; while also being sweet enough to make hentai lovers begging for more. Shorts include the two-part “WondARFul” mini-arc, about a buxom dog walker who struts her way into AV history by participating in some on-camera puppy love; and the lead story “Flappy Cat,” that pits a tough-luck commuter and a young stray looking for attention and affection.

(Source: Fakku)

Haruzake Nao is a sweet boy who has started work at a flower shop. His cousin, Monjirou, is the intimidating Vice President of the Tadano Group. Since childhood Monjirou has protected Nao from all sorts of trouble.

While Monjirou may harbor secret intentions towards Nao, Nao himself may think of Monjirou as more than just a childhood friend. Monjirou is, after all, his hero!
